key: A guaranteed prize must be backed by a cash sponsor contribution for this tournament that may be used for prizes.
english: A guaranteed prize must be backed by a cash sponsor contribution for this tournament that may be used for prizes.
arabic: يجب أن تكون الجائزة المضمونة مدعومة بمساهمة نقدية من راعٍ لهذه البطولة يُسمح باستخدامها للجوائز.

key: A note is required (who decided the points table, where it is documented).
english: A note is required (who decided the points table, where it is documented).
arabic: الملاحظة مطلوبة (من قرّر جدول النقاط، وأين وُثّق القرار).

key: A payment is already recorded for this entry. Void it first if it was a mistake.
english: A payment is already recorded for this entry. Void it first if it was a mistake.
arabic: تم تسجيل دفعة لهذا الاشتراك بالفعل. ألغِها أولًا إذا كانت خطأ.

key: A prize is guaranteed by this contribution. Change that prize first.
english: A prize is guaranteed by this contribution. Change that prize first.
arabic: هناك جائزة مضمونة بهذه المساهمة. عدّل تلك الجائزة أولاً.

key: A public reason is required to cancel or postpone a tournament.
english: A public reason is required to cancel or postpone a tournament.
arabic: يجب ذكر سبب معلن لإلغاء البطولة أو تأجيلها.

key: A reason is required to change locked rules: :fields.
english: A reason is required to change locked rules: :fields.
arabic: يجب ذكر سبب لتغيير القواعد المقفلة: :fields.

key: A reason is required to correct an approved result.
english: A reason is required to correct an approved result.
arabic: يلزم ذكر سبب لتصحيح نتيجة معتمدة.

key: A reversal cannot be reversed. Record a new entry instead.
english: A reversal cannot be reversed. Record a new entry instead.
arabic: لا يمكن عكس قيد عكسي. سجّل قيداً جديداً بدلاً من ذلك.

key: a roster minimum of at least 2 for pair/team registration
english: a roster minimum of at least 2 for pair/team registration
arabic: حد أدنى للتشكيلة لا يقل عن 2 لتسجيل الثنائيات والفرق

key: A share of the prize pool can only be finalized after the finance rules are approved and registration has closed.
english: A share of the prize pool can only be finalized after the finance rules are approved and registration has closed.
arabic: لا يمكن اعتماد حصة من مجموع الجوائز نهائياً إلا بعد الموافقة على القواعد المالية وإغلاق التسجيل.

key: A tournament cannot move from :from to :to.
english: A tournament cannot move from :from to :to.
arabic: لا يمكن نقل البطولة من «:from» إلى «:to».

key: A tournament with registrations cannot return to draft.
english: A tournament with registrations cannot return to draft.
arabic: لا يمكن إعادة بطولة فيها تسجيلات إلى المسودة.

key: Add a product with photos and sizes, then submit it. RIVALO staff review every product before it goes on sale.
english: Add a product with photos and sizes, then submit it. RIVALO staff review every product before it goes on sale.
arabic: أضف منتجًا بصوره ومقاساته ثم أرسله. يراجع موظفو RIVALO كل منتج قبل عرضه للبيع.

key: Add at least one rule that awards points before publishing.
english: Add at least one rule that awards points before publishing.
arabic: أضف قاعدة واحدة على الأقل تمنح نقاطاً قبل النشر.

key: Add at least one size or option.
english: Add at least one size or option.
arabic: أضف مقاسًا أو خيارًا واحدًا على الأقل.

key: Add your first product, then submit it for review.
english: Add your first product, then submit it for review.
arabic: أضف منتجك الأول ثم أرسله للمراجعة.

key: All the shop's products are archived. Hand unsold stock back with "Returned to seller" and settle the balance.
english: All the shop's products are archived. Hand unsold stock back with "Returned to seller" and settle the balance.
arabic: تُؤرشف كل منتجات المتجر. سلّم المخزون غير المباع عبر «أُعيد إلى البائع» وسوِّ الرصيد.

key: Also send as a phone notification
english: Also send as a phone notification

key: An approval note is required (for example, who decided and where it is documented).
english: An approval note is required (for example, who decided and where it is documented).
arabic: ملاحظة الموافقة مطلوبة (مثلاً: من قرّر وأين وُثّق القرار).

key: Append-only. Corrections appear as reversal entries; nothing is edited or deleted.
english: Append-only. Corrections appear as reversal entries; nothing is edited or deleted.
arabic: سجل إضافة فقط. تظهر التصحيحات كقيود عكسية، ولا يُعدَّل أو يُحذف أي شيء.

key: Approval note (who decided, where it is documented)
english: Approval note (who decided, where it is documented)
arabic: ملاحظة الموافقة (من قرّر، وأين وُثّق القرار)

key: Approve only after the seller signed the RIVALO seller agreement. The person can then sign in to the Seller Hub with their RIVALO account.
english: Approve only after the seller signed the RIVALO seller agreement. The person can then sign in to the Seller Hub with their RIVALO account.
arabic: اعتمد البائع فقط بعد توقيعه اتفاقية البائعين مع RIVALO. بعدها يمكنه الدخول إلى مركز البائعين بحسابه في RIVALO.

key: Approving allows organizer-share payouts and prize amounts based on these shares. Approve only rules the owner has actually decided.
english: Approving allows organizer-share payouts and prize amounts based on these shares. Approve only rules the owner has actually decided.
arabic: الموافقة تسمح بصرف حصة المنظم ومبالغ الجوائز المبنية على هذه الحصص. وافق فقط على قواعد قرّرها المالك فعلاً.

key: As written in the signed agreement. Applies to orders placed from now on.
english: As written in the signed agreement. Applies to orders placed from now on.
arabic: كما هي مكتوبة في الاتفاقية الموقّعة. تُطبَّق على الطلبات الجديدة من الآن.

key: At least two entrants must reach the knockout. Use smaller groups or let more advance.
english: At least two entrants must reach the knockout. Use smaller groups or let more advance.
arabic: يجب أن يتأهل مشاركان على الأقل لخروج المغلوب. استخدم مجموعات أصغر أو اسمح بتأهل عدد أكبر.

key: Bring the stock to RIVALO. Staff count it in, and only items RIVALO holds can be bought.
english: Bring the stock to RIVALO. Staff count it in, and only items RIVALO holds can be bought.
arabic: أحضر المخزون إلى RIVALO. يعدّه الموظفون، ولا يمكن شراء إلا ما تحتفظ به RIVALO.

key: Cash was already received. Reverse the receipts first.
english: Cash was already received. Reverse the receipts first.
arabic: تم استلام نقد بالفعل. اعكس الإيصالات أولاً.

key: Charged on top of the items and collected in cash on delivery. 0 = free delivery.
english: Charged on top of the items and collected in cash on delivery. 0 = free delivery.
arabic: تُضاف إلى سعر المنتجات وتُحصّل نقدًا عند التوصيل. 0 = توصيل مجاني.

key: Check name, photos and price before they go on sale.
english: Check name, photos and price before they go on sale.
arabic: تحقّق من الاسم والصور والسعر قبل عرضها للبيع.

key: Check-in has closed. Add a reason to record a late check-in.
english: Check-in has closed. Add a reason to record a late check-in.
arabic: انتهى وقت تسجيل الحضور. أضف سببًا لتسجيل حضور متأخر.

key: Choose a time in the future.
english: Choose a time in the future.

key: Choose how this cash may be used (unrestricted, prizes only, or expenses only).
english: Choose how this cash may be used (unrestricted, prizes only, or expenses only).
arabic: اختر كيف يمكن استخدام هذا النقد (غير مقيد، للجوائز فقط، أو للمصاريف فقط).

key: Choose who should receive this announcement.
english: Choose who should receive this announcement.

key: Close registration before making the draw.
english: Close registration before making the draw.

key: Confirm that the items are set aside for this customer.
english: Confirm that the items are set aside for this customer.
arabic: أكّد أن المنتجات محجوزة لهذا العميل.

key: Confirm the player's identity against the roster photos and names first.
english: Confirm the player's identity against the roster photos and names first.
arabic: تحقّق أولًا من هوية اللاعب بمقارنته بصور وأسماء التشكيلة.

key: Confirm you received :fee in cash. A receipt number is created for the player.
english: Confirm you received :fee in cash. A receipt number is created for the player.
arabic: أكّد أنك استلمت :fee نقدًا. سيُنشأ رقم إيصال للاعب.

key: Contact details are private to finance staff.
english: Contact details are private to finance staff.

key: Contact the customer, or cancel to put the items back in stock.
english: Contact the customer, or cancel to put the items back in stock.
arabic: تواصل مع العميل، أو ألغِ الطلب لإعادة المنتجات إلى المخزون.

key: Corrections never edit or delete records: an opposite entry is added. Entry fees and refunds are corrected at the check-in desk.
english: Corrections never edit or delete records: an opposite entry is added. Entry fees and refunds are corrected at the check-in desk.
arabic: التصحيحات لا تعدّل السجلات ولا تحذفها: يُضاف قيد معاكس. رسوم الاشتراك والمبالغ المستردة تُصحَّح من مكتب تسجيل الحضور.

key: Counted when the customer has them and has paid
english: Counted when the customer has them and has paid

key: Counts only approved results, confirmed placements and venue check-ins. "Manual" badges are awarded by staff with a reason.
english: Counts only approved results, confirmed placements and venue check-ins. "Manual" badges are awarded by staff with a reason.
arabic: يُحتسب فقط من النتائج المعتمدة والترتيب المؤكد وتسجيلات الحضور. الأوسمة "اليدوية" يمنحها الطاقم مع ذكر السبب.

key: Counts when the match ended by
english: Counts when the match ended by

key: Create and play the knockout stage first.
english: Create and play the knockout stage first.
arabic: أنشئ مرحلة خروج المغلوب والعبها أولاً.

key: Create the sponsor first under Finance → Sponsors.
english: Create the sponsor first under Finance → Sponsors.
arabic: أنشئ الراعي أولاً من المالية ← الرعاة.

key: Customers order in the RIVALO app and pay in cash at pickup or delivery. You never need their contact details.
english: Customers order in the RIVALO app and pay in cash at pickup or delivery. You never need their contact details.
arabic: يطلب العملاء عبر تطبيق RIVALO ويدفعون نقدًا عند الاستلام أو التوصيل. لن تحتاج أبدًا إلى بيانات تواصلهم.

key: Customers pay in cash when they collect or receive their order. Record the payment when you hand it over.
english: Customers pay in cash when they collect or receive their order. Record the payment when you hand it over.
arabic: يدفع العملاء نقدًا عند استلام طلبهم أو توصيله. سجّل الدفع عند التسليم.

key: Describe what changed in this version.
english: Describe what changed in this version.
arabic: صف ما تغيّر في هذا الإصدار.

key: Disciplines marked "not ready" can be drafted but not published.
english: Disciplines marked "not ready" can be drafted but not published.
arabic: يمكن إنشاء مسودات للفئات الموسومة «غير جاهزة» ولكن لا يمكن نشرها.

key: Do not enable compliance-gated features until the required approvals are documented in docs/05-DECISIONS.md.
english: Do not enable compliance-gated features until the required approvals are documented in docs/05-DECISIONS.md.
arabic: لا تفعّل الميزات الخاضعة للامتثال قبل توثيق الموافقات المطلوبة في docs/05-DECISIONS.md.

key: Draft: projections only, no formula-based payouts
english: Draft: projections only, no formula-based payouts
arabic: مسودة: توقعات فقط، دون صرف مبالغ محسوبة بالمعادلة

key: Draw made. Check it, then publish the fixtures.
english: Draw made. Check it, then publish the fixtures.
arabic: تمت القرعة. راجعها ثم انشر المباريات.

key: Enter a cash amount, an item (trophy, medals…), or both.
english: Enter a cash amount, an item (trophy, medals…), or both.
arabic: أدخل مبلغاً نقدياً أو عنصراً (كأس، ميداليات…) أو كليهما.

key: Enter an amount other than zero.
english: Enter an amount other than zero.

key: Enter the amount the sponsor committed.
english: Enter the amount the sponsor committed.
arabic: أدخل المبلغ الذي التزم به الراعي.

key: Enter the winner who received the prize.
english: Enter the winner who received the prize.

key: Enter who reviewed it and a note (for example the date of their written approval).
english: Enter who reviewed it and a note (for example the date of their written approval).
arabic: أدخل من راجعها وملاحظة (مثل تاريخ موافقته الكتابية).
لا يمكن أن تكون رسوم الاشتراك سالبة.

key: Entry fees and refunds follow the venue receipts. Void the receipt at the check-in desk instead.
english: Entry fees and refunds follow the venue receipts. Void the receipt at the check-in desk instead.
arabic: رسوم الاشتراك والمبالغ المستردة تتبع إيصالات المكان. ألغِ الإيصال من مكتب تسجيل الحضور بدلاً من ذلك.

key: Estimated: may change. Finalized: confirmed amount. Guaranteed: backed by sponsor cash already received.
english: Estimated: may change. Finalized: confirmed amount. Guaranteed: backed by sponsor cash already received.
arabic: تقديرية: قد تتغير. نهائية: مبلغ مؤكد. مضمونة: مدعومة بنقد من راعٍ تم استلامه بالفعل.

key: Every group match needs an approved result first.
english: Every group match needs an approved result first.
arabic: كل مباريات المجموعات تحتاج إلى نتيجة معتمدة أولاً.

key: Every match must have an approved result. Placements and placement/participation points are recorded, and the tournament is marked completed.
english: Every match must have an approved result. Placements and placement/participation points are recorded, and the tournament is marked completed.
arabic: يجب أن تكون لكل مباراة نتيجة معتمدة. يُسجَّل الترتيب ونقاط المراكز والمشاركة، وتُعلَّم البطولة كمكتملة.

key: Every match needs an approved result before placements are final.
english: Every match needs an approved result before placements are final.
arabic: كل مباراة تحتاج إلى نتيجة معتمدة قبل تثبيت الترتيب النهائي.

key: Expenses can be paid from the expense fund or unrestricted money only.
english: Expenses can be paid from the expense fund or unrestricted money only.
arabic: تُدفع المصاريف من صندوق المصاريف أو من المال غير المقيد فقط.

key: Explain the method if "Published other" is chosen.
english: Explain the method if "Published other" is chosen.
arabic: اشرح الطريقة إذا اخترت «طريقة أخرى معلنة».

key: Explain what is wrong with the result.
english: Explain what is wrong with the result.

key: Feature at the top of the store
english: Feature at the top of the store

key: Featured articles appear in the slider on Home and News.
english: Featured articles appear in the slider on Home and News.
arabic: تظهر المقالات المميزة في شريط الصور في الرئيسية والأخبار.

key: Figures come straight from each tournament's money records. Projections follow the finance rules; drafts are not approved and do not allow formula-based payouts.
english: Figures come straight from each tournament's money records. Projections follow the finance rules; drafts are not approved and do not allow formula-based payouts.
arabic: الأرقام مأخوذة مباشرة من السجلات المالية لكل بطولة. التوقعات تتبع القواعد المالية؛ المسودات غير معتمدة ولا تسمح بصرف مبالغ محسوبة بالمعادلة.

key: Financial rules are locked because registration has opened. A reason is required for this correction.
english: Financial rules are locked because registration has opened. A reason is required for this correction.
arabic: القواعد المالية مقفلة لأن التسجيل قد فُتح. يلزم ذكر سبب لهذا التصحيح.

key: Fixture generation for each format arrives in Milestone 5.
english: Fixture generation for each format arrives in Milestone 5.
arabic: إنشاء جدول المباريات لكل صيغة يأتي في المرحلة 5.

key: For example S, M, XL or One size.
english: For example S, M, XL or One size.
arabic: مثلًا S أو M أو XL أو مقاس واحد.

key: For example the contract number or the date it was signed.
english: For example the contract number or the date it was signed.
arabic: مثلًا رقم العقد أو تاريخ توقيعه.

key: For example: ID card seen, business registration number, visited the shop. Do not upload or copy ID numbers here.
english: For example: ID card seen, business registration number, visited the shop. Do not upload or copy ID numbers here.
arabic: مثلًا: اطّلعت على الهوية، رقم السجل التجاري، زرت المتجر. لا ترفع أرقام الهويات ولا تنسخها هنا.

key: For set-based sports. Sets decide the winner; leave the scores empty.
english: For set-based sports. Sets decide the winner; leave the scores empty.
arabic: للرياضات التي تُلعب بالأشواط. الأشواط تحدد الفائز؛ اترك النتيجة فارغة.

key: Group winners are seeded first, so teams from the same group are kept apart in the first knockout round.
english: Group winners are seeded first, so teams from the same group are kept apart in the first knockout round.
arabic: يُصنَّف متصدرو المجموعات أولاً، فلا يلتقي فريقان من المجموعة نفسها في أول أدوار خروج المغلوب.

key: Groups need at least 2 entrants, and fewer must advance than play in each group.
english: Groups need at least 2 entrants, and fewer must advance than play in each group.
arabic: تحتاج المجموعة إلى مشاركين اثنين على الأقل، ويجب أن يكون عدد المتأهلين أقل من عدد اللاعبين في كل مجموعة.

key: Guaranteed needs sponsor cash already received. Finalized pool shares need approved rules and closed registration.
english: Guaranteed needs sponsor cash already received. Finalized pool shares need approved rules and closed registration.
arabic: المضمونة تتطلب نقداً من راعٍ تم استلامه. الحصص النهائية من مجموع الجوائز تتطلب قواعد معتمدة وتسجيلاً مغلقاً.

key: Guaranteed prizes can only be promised from sponsor cash already received (:received received).
english: Guaranteed prizes can only be promised from sponsor cash already received (:received received).
arabic: لا يمكن ضمان الجوائز إلا من نقد الرعاة المستلم فعلاً (المستلم: :received).

key: Guaranteed prizes depend on this money. Change those prizes first.
english: Guaranteed prizes depend on this money. Change those prizes first.
arabic: هناك جوائز مضمونة تعتمد على هذا المال. عدّل تلك الجوائز أولاً.

key: Hand the items back with "Returned to seller" when they collect them.
english: Hand the items back with "Returned to seller" when they collect them.
arabic: سلّم المنتجات عبر «أُعيد إلى البائع» عندما يستلمها.

key: How the cash may be used
english: How the cash may be used

key: I checked who this seller is and the agreement is signed.
english: I checked who this seller is and the agreement is signed.
arabic: تحققت من هوية هذا البائع، والاتفاقية موقّعة.

key: I confirm a qualified reviewer approved this exact version.
english: I confirm a qualified reviewer approved this exact version.
arabic: أؤكد أن مراجعًا مؤهلًا وافق على هذا الإصدار بعينه.

key: IANA timezone. Times are stored in UTC and shown in this zone.
english: IANA timezone. Times are stored in UTC and shown in this zone.
arabic: منطقة زمنية حسب IANA. تُخزَّن الأوقات بتوقيت UTC وتُعرض بهذه المنطقة.

key: Icon key used by the app (e.g. football, padel, cue, controller).
english: Icon key used by the app (e.g. football, padel, cue, controller).
arabic: مفتاح الأيقونة في التطبيق (مثل football وpadel وcue وcontroller).

key: Inactive sports are hidden from players.
english: Inactive sports are hidden from players.
arabic: الرياضات غير النشطة مخفية عن اللاعبين.
يشمل نقد الرعاة المخصص للجوائز والمستلم

key: Individual tournaments have a roster of exactly one player.
english: Individual tournaments have a roster of exactly one player.
arabic: البطولات الفردية تشكيلتها لاعب واحد فقط.

key: IQD has no minor unit, so 25000 means 25,000 IQD. A size can override it.
english: IQD has no minor unit, so 25000 means 25,000 IQD. A size can override it.
arabic: الدينار العراقي ليس له وحدة أصغر، فـ 25000 تعني 25,000 دينار. يمكن لمقاس أن يغيّره.

key: IQD has no minor unit, so 25000 means 25,000 IQD. Paid in person at the venue only.
english: IQD has no minor unit, so 25000 means 25,000 IQD. Paid in person at the venue only.
arabic: ليس للدينار العراقي وحدة أصغر، لذا 25000 تعني 25,000 دينار. يُدفع حضوريًا في مكان البطولة فقط.

key: Leave empty for a new random draw.
english: Leave empty for a new random draw.

key: Leave empty to publish immediately. A future time schedules the article.
english: Leave empty to publish immediately. A future time schedules the article.
arabic: اتركه فارغاً للنشر فوراً. الوقت المستقبلي يجدول المقال.

key: Leave empty to use the product price.
english: Leave empty to use the product price.

arabic: اتركه فارغاً ما دام القرار لم يُتخذ (القرار D4).

key: Live counts from the database. Sample (seeded) records are shown separately.
english: Live counts from the database. Sample (seeded) records are shown separately.
arabic: أرقام حية من قاعدة البيانات. السجلات التجريبية تُعرض بشكل منفصل.

key: Localized names shown in the app. Use locale codes: ar (Arabic), kmr (Kurdish, Kurmanji).
english: Localized names shown in the app. Use locale codes: ar (Arabic), kmr (Kurdish, Kurmanji).
arabic: الأسماء المترجمة المعروضة في التطبيق. استخدم رموز اللغات: ar (العربية)، kmr (الكردية الكرمانجية).

key: Locked since :date: changes need a reason
english: Locked since :date: changes need a reason

key: Material rules are locked because registration has opened. Ask a super admin to make a documented correction.
english: Material rules are locked because registration has opened. Ask a super admin to make a documented correction.
arabic: القواعد الأساسية مقفلة لأن التسجيل قد بدأ. اطلب من المدير العام إجراء تصحيح موثّق.

key: Maximum active members per team. Leave empty for individual-only sports.
english: Maximum active members per team. Leave empty for individual-only sports.
arabic: الحد الأقصى للأعضاء النشطين لكل فريق. اتركه فارغًا للرياضات الفردية فقط.

key: Minimum entrants must be at least 2 and not exceed maximum entrants.
english: Minimum entrants must be at least 2 and not exceed maximum entrants.
arabic: يجب ألا يقل الحد الأدنى للمشاركين عن 2 وألا يتجاوز الحد الأقصى.

key: Money was already paid for this prize. Reverse the payout before changing the amount.
english: Money was already paid for this prize. Reverse the payout before changing the amount.
arabic: تم دفع مال لهذه الجائزة بالفعل. اعكس الدفعة قبل تغيير المبلغ.

key: Money was received for this order. Record the refund first.
english: Money was received for this order. Record the refund first.
arabic: استُلم مال لهذا الطلب. سجّل الاسترداد أولًا.

key: More items returned than were bought.
english: More items returned than were bought.

key: Moves unrestricted money into a purpose fund. Restricted sponsor money can never be moved.
english: Moves unrestricted money into a purpose fund. Restricted sponsor money can never be moved.
arabic: ينقل المال غير المقيد إلى صندوق مخصص. لا يمكن أبداً نقل أموال الرعاة المقيدة.

key: Needed for walkovers, forfeits, no-shows, disqualifications and knockout tiebreaks.
english: Needed for walkovers, forfeits, no-shows, disqualifications and knockout tiebreaks.
arabic: مطلوب للفوز بالانسحاب والتنازل وعدم الحضور والاستبعاد وكسر التعادل في خروج المغلوب.

key: New sellers are added by approving a seller application.
english: New sellers are added by approving a seller application.
arabic: يُضاف البائعون الجدد باعتماد طلب بائع.

key: No breach found. The reporter is told their report was reviewed.
english: No breach found. The reporter is told their report was reviewed.
arabic: لا توجد مخالفة. يُبلَّغ المُبلِّغ بأن بلاغه رُوجع.

key: No draw yet. Close registration and check entrants in, then make the draw.
english: No draw yet. Close registration and check entrants in, then make the draw.
arabic: لا توجد قرعة بعد. أغلق التسجيل وسجّل حضور المشاركين، ثم أجرِ القرعة.
لا توجد طلبات في هذه الفترة.

key: No photo, or it was removed since
english: No photo, or it was removed since
arabic: لا توجد صورة، أو أُزيلت منذ ذلك الحين

key: No published points table: results award no ranking points
english: No published points table: results award no ranking points
arabic: لا يوجد جدول نقاط منشور: النتائج لا تمنح نقاط ترتيب

key: No shop is linked to this account.
english: No shop is linked to this account.
arabic: لا يوجد متجر مرتبط بهذا الحساب.

key: No tournaments with money activity yet.
english: No tournaments with money activity yet.
arabic: لا توجد بطولات بنشاط مالي بعد.

key: Not enough money in the :fund fund (:balance available).
english: Not enough money in the :fund fund (:balance available).
arabic: لا يوجد مال كافٍ في صندوق :fund (المتوفر :balance).

key: Note (for example the date and reference of the written approval)
english: Note (for example the date and reference of the written approval)

key: Nothing changed since the last published version.
english: Nothing changed since the last published version.
arabic: لم يتغير شيء منذ آخر إصدار منشور.

key: Nothing needs your attention right now.
english: Nothing needs your attention right now.
arabic: لا شيء يحتاج إلى انتباهك الآن.
لا يوجد شيء في كشف حسابك بعد
لم يُبع شيء في هذه الفترة.

key: One or two sentences shown on cards and in the slider.
english: One or two sentences shown on cards and in the slider.
arabic: جملة أو جملتان تظهران على البطاقات وفي شريط الصور.

key: Only :count eligible entrants (checked in, fee settled). At least :min are needed.
english: Only :count eligible entrants (checked in, fee settled). At least :min are needed.
arabic: يوجد :count مشاركين مؤهلين فقط (سجّلوا الحضور وسدّدوا الرسوم). المطلوب :min على الأقل.

key: Only a draft can be published.
english: Only a draft can be published.

key: Only a fixed cash amount can be guaranteed.
english: Only a fixed cash amount can be guaranteed.
arabic: يمكن ضمان مبلغ نقدي ثابت فقط.

key: Only a published points table can be used.
english: Only a published points table can be used.
arabic: يمكن استخدام جدول نقاط منشور فقط.

key: Only a published table can be retired.
english: Only a published table can be retired.

key: Only a scheduled announcement can be cancelled.
english: Only a scheduled announcement can be cancelled.

key: Only a super admin can record a legal review.
english: Only a super admin can record a legal review.
arabic: وحده المدير العام يمكنه تسجيل مراجعة قانونية.

key: Only active badges are awarded and shown in the app.
english: Only active badges are awarded and shown in the app.
arabic: تُمنح الأوسمة النشطة فقط وتظهر في التطبيق.

key: Only active products are visible and can be bought.
english: Only active products are visible and can be bought.
arabic: المنتجات النشطة فقط تظهر ويمكن شراؤها.

key: Only after a new agreement is signed. Orders already placed keep the old rate.
english: Only after a new agreement is signed. Orders already placed keep the old rate.
arabic: فقط بعد توقيع اتفاقية جديدة. الطلبات السابقة تحتفظ بالنسبة القديمة.

key: Only cash contributions are recorded in the money records.
english: Only cash contributions are recorded in the money records.
arabic: تُسجَّل المساهمات النقدية فقط في السجلات المالية.

key: Only entries with a reserved place can pay. Waitlisted or cancelled entries cannot.
english: Only entries with a reserved place can pay. Waitlisted or cancelled entries cannot.
arabic: يمكن الدفع فقط للاشتراكات التي لها مكان محجوز، وليس لقائمة الانتظار أو الاشتراكات الملغاة.

key: Only finance managers can change tournament money records.
english: Only finance managers can change tournament money records.
arabic: مديرو المالية فقط يمكنهم تغيير السجلات المالية للبطولة.

key: Only finance staff can record seller payouts and adjustments.
english: Only finance staff can record seller payouts and adjustments.
arabic: موظفو المالية فقط يمكنهم تسجيل دفعات البائعين وتسوياتهم.

key: Only for corrections both sides agreed, for example a damaged item the seller accepted to bear. Use a minus sign when the seller owes RIVALO.
english: Only for corrections both sides agreed, for example a damaged item the seller accepted to bear. Use a minus sign when the seller owes RIVALO.
arabic: فقط لتصحيحات اتفق عليها الطرفان، مثل منتج تالف قبل البائع تحمّله. استخدم إشارة السالب عندما يكون المبلغ على البائع لـ RIVALO.

key: Only listings waiting for review can be approved.
english: Only listings waiting for review can be approved.
arabic: يمكن اعتماد المنتجات التي بانتظار المراجعة فقط.

key: Only listings waiting for review or on sale can be sent back.
english: Only listings waiting for review or on sale can be sent back.
arabic: يمكن إعادة المنتجات التي بانتظار المراجعة أو المعروضة للبيع فقط.

key: Only points managers can change points tables.
english: Only points managers can change points tables.
arabic: مديرو النقاط فقط يمكنهم تغيير جداول النقاط.

key: Only points managers can choose a tournament's points rules.
english: Only points managers can choose a tournament's points rules.
arabic: مديرو النقاط فقط يمكنهم اختيار قواعد نقاط البطولة.

key: Only published tables appear. Points are locked after the first award.
english: Only published tables appear. Points are locked after the first award.
arabic: تظهر الجداول المنشورة فقط. تُقفل النقاط بعد أول منح.

key: Only staff who manage badges can do this.
english: Only staff who manage badges can do this.
arabic: فقط الطاقم الذي يدير الأوسمة يمكنه ذلك.

key: Only staff who send announcements can do this.
english: Only staff who send announcements can do this.
arabic: فقط الطاقم الذي يرسل الإعلانات يمكنه ذلك.

key: Only store staff can change orders.
english: Only store staff can change orders.
arabic: وحدهم موظفو المتجر يمكنهم تعديل الطلبات.

key: Only what you can act on. Counts come straight from the database.
english: Only what you can act on. Counts come straight from the database.
arabic: فقط ما يمكنك التصرف فيه. الأعداد مأخوذة مباشرة من قاعدة البيانات.

key: Opened at your own risk: check the address before you visit it.
english: Opened at your own risk: check the address before you visit it.
arabic: افتحه على مسؤوليتك: تحقّق من العنوان قبل زيارته.

key: Orders for your products appear here.
english: Orders for your products appear here.

key: Orders not collected for over a week
english: Orders not collected for over a week
arabic: طلبات لم تُستلم منذ أكثر من أسبوع

key: Orders placed in the period. "Received" is cash staff recorded at handover; "Refunded" is cash recorded as handed back. Sample orders are shown separately.
english: Orders placed in the period. "Received" is cash staff recorded at handover; "Refunded" is cash recorded as handed back. Sample orders are shown separately.
arabic: الطلبات المقدمة خلال الفترة. «المستلم» هو النقد الذي سجّله الموظفون عند التسليم، و«المسترد» هو النقد المسجّل كمُعاد. تُعرض الطلبات التجريبية بشكل منفصل.

key: Organizer share under the approved rules: :share. Record only cash actually handed over.
english: Organizer share under the approved rules: :share. Record only cash actually handed over.
arabic: حصة المنظم وفق القواعد المعتمدة: :share. سجّل فقط النقد الذي سُلّم فعلاً.

key: Other reports about the same subject
english: Other reports about the same subject

key: Paid-entry participation is DISABLED (compliance flag, decision D7). Tournaments with an entry fee above 0 can be drafted but not published. Free tournaments work normally.
english: Paid-entry participation is DISABLED (compliance flag, decision D7). Tournaments with an entry fee above 0 can be drafted but not published. Free tournaments work normally.
arabic: المشاركة المدفوعة معطّلة (مفتاح الامتثال، القرار D7). يمكن إنشاء مسودات لبطولات برسوم أكبر من 0 ولكن لا يمكن نشرها. البطولات المجانية تعمل بشكل طبيعي.

key: Paid-entry participation is ENABLED. Fees are collected in person by staff only; there is no online checkout.
english: Paid-entry participation is ENABLED. Fees are collected in person by staff only; there is no online checkout.
arabic: المشاركة المدفوعة مفعّلة. تُحصَّل الرسوم حضوريًا من قبل الموظفين فقط، ولا يوجد دفع إلكتروني.

key: Paid-entry participation is not enabled. It stays off until legal, payment and app-store eligibility is confirmed. Set the entry fee to 0 for a free tournament.
english: Paid-entry participation is not enabled. It stays off until legal, payment and app-store eligibility is confirmed. Set the entry fee to 0 for a free tournament.
arabic: المشاركة المدفوعة غير مفعّلة، وستبقى كذلك حتى تأكيد الأهلية القانونية وأهلية الدفع ومتاجر التطبيقات. اجعل الرسوم 0 لبطولة مجانية.

key: Paid-entry participation is not enabled. New payments cannot be recorded.
english: Paid-entry participation is not enabled. New payments cannot be recorded.
arabic: المشاركة المدفوعة غير مفعّلة. لا يمكن تسجيل دفعات جديدة.

key: Pair tournaments have a roster of exactly two players.
english: Pair tournaments have a roster of exactly two players.

key: Pairs register as two-player teams so partners must accept an invitation first.
english: Pairs register as two-player teams so partners must accept an invitation first.
arabic: يُسجَّل الثنائي كفريق من لاعبَين، لذا يجب أن يقبل الشريك الدعوة أولًا.

key: Part of the product link. Letters, numbers and dashes.
english: Part of the product link. Letters, numbers and dashes.
arabic: جزء من رابط المنتج. أحرف وأرقام وشرطات.

key: Part of the shop link. Letters, numbers and dashes.
english: Part of the shop link. Letters, numbers and dashes.
arabic: جزء من رابط المتجر. أحرف وأرقام وشرطات.

key: Paused or closed shops with stock here
english: Paused or closed shops with stock here
arabic: متاجر موقوفة أو مغلقة لها مخزون لدينا

key: Payouts based on these rules are already recorded. Reverse them before changing the rules.
english: Payouts based on these rules are already recorded. Reverse them before changing the rules.
arabic: هناك دفعات مسجلة مبنية على هذه القواعد. اعكسها قبل تغيير القواعد.
يجب أن يكون المركز بين 1 و64.

key: Plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph. A short line on its own is shown as a heading.
english: Plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph. A short line on its own is shown as a heading.
arabic: نص عادي. السطر الفارغ يبدأ فقرة جديدة. السطر القصير المنفرد يُعرض كعنوان.

key: Plain text. Leave an empty line between paragraphs.
english: Plain text. Leave an empty line between paragraphs.
arabic: نص عادي. اترك سطراً فارغاً بين الفقرات.

key: Players cannot read them in the app yet.
english: Players cannot read them in the app yet.
arabic: لا يستطيع اللاعبون قراءتها في التطبيق بعد.

key: Players who asked to sell on RIVALO.
english: Players who asked to sell on RIVALO.

key: Players who turned this category off still see the message in their inbox, without a phone notification.
english: Players who turned this category off still see the message in their inbox, without a phone notification.
arabic: اللاعبون الذين أوقفوا هذه الفئة سيرون الرسالة في صندوق الوارد دون إشعار على الهاتف.

key: Players will see the fixtures in the app.
english: Players will see the fixtures in the app.

key: Players will see the saved draft as a new version. Its legal review will show as pending until a super admin records a review for this version. Save the draft first.
english: Players will see the saved draft as a new version. Its legal review will show as pending until a super admin records a review for this version. Save the draft first.
arabic: سيرى اللاعبون المسودة المحفوظة كإصدار جديد. ستظهر مراجعتها القانونية معلّقة حتى يسجّل مدير عام مراجعة لهذا الإصدار. احفظ المسودة أولًا.

key: Players will see the saved draft as a new version. Save the draft first.
english: Players will see the saved draft as a new version. Save the draft first.
arabic: سيرى اللاعبون المسودة المحفوظة كإصدار جديد. احفظ المسودة أولًا.

key: Points consequences of no-shows are defined by the published points rules (decision D11). Nothing is awarded or deducted here.
english: Points consequences of no-shows are defined by the published points rules (decision D11). Nothing is awarded or deducted here.
arabic: تبعات الغياب على النقاط تحددها قواعد النقاط المعلنة (القرار D11). لا يُمنح أو يُخصم شيء هنا.

key: Points rules and awards arrive in Milestone 5. No points are awarded yet.
english: Points rules and awards arrive in Milestone 5. No points are awarded yet.
arabic: قواعد النقاط ومنحها تأتي في المرحلة 5. لم تُمنح أي نقاط بعد.

key: Points rules are locked because points were already awarded in this tournament.
english: Points rules are locked because points were already awarded in this tournament.
arabic: قواعد النقاط مقفلة لأن نقاطاً مُنحت بالفعل في هذه البطولة.

key: Private: never shown in the app or public API.
english: Private: never shown in the app or public API.
arabic: خاص: لا يظهر أبدًا في التطبيق أو الواجهة العامة.

key: Private: never shown to the reported player.
english: Private: never shown to the reported player.
arabic: خاص: لا يُعرض أبدًا للاعب المُبلَّغ عنه.

key: Private: shown only to staff and checked-in entrants.
english: Private: shown only to staff and checked-in entrants.
arabic: خاص: يظهر للموظفين والمشاركين الذين سجّلوا حضورهم فقط.

key: Prize fund money can only pay prizes. Expense fund money can only pay expenses. Only unrestricted money can be set aside or pay the organizer.
english: Prize fund money can only pay prizes. Expense fund money can only pay expenses. Only unrestricted money can be set aside or pay the organizer.
arabic: أموال صندوق الجوائز تُدفع للجوائز فقط. أموال صندوق المصاريف تُدفع للمصاريف فقط. المال غير المقيد وحده يمكن تخصيصه أو دفعه للمنظم.

key: Prize shares together cannot exceed 100% of the prize pool.
english: Prize shares together cannot exceed 100% of the prize pool.
arabic: لا يمكن أن تتجاوز حصص الجوائز معاً 100% من مجموع الجوائز.

key: Prizes are paid after the tournament is completed.
english: Prizes are paid after the tournament is completed.

key: Prizes can be paid from the prize fund or unrestricted money only.
english: Prizes can be paid from the prize fund or unrestricted money only.
arabic: تُدفع الجوائز من صندوق الجوائز أو من المال غير المقيد فقط.

key: Prizes only: can never pay the organizer or expenses.
english: Prizes only: can never pay the organizer or expenses.
arabic: للجوائز فقط: لا يمكن أبداً أن تُدفع للمنظم أو للمصاريف.

key: Profile content belongs to the player. Staff manage status and roles only.
english: Profile content belongs to the player. Staff manage status and roles only.
arabic: محتوى الملف الشخصي ملك للاعب. يدير الموظفون الحالة والأدوار فقط.

key: Publish prize amounts or formulas, deductions and refund conditions before registration opens. Label estimates as "Estimated".
english: Publish prize amounts or formulas, deductions and refund conditions before registration opens. Label estimates as "Estimated".
arabic: انشر مبالغ الجوائز أو طريقة حسابها والاستقطاعات وشروط الاسترداد قبل فتح التسجيل. ضع على التقديرات وسم «تقديري».

key: Publish the page first. A review is recorded for a published version.
english: Publish the page first. A review is recorded for a published version.
arabic: انشر الصفحة أولًا. تُسجَّل المراجعة لإصدار منشور.

key: Published eligibility. Do not add age rules until decision D6 is resolved.
english: Published eligibility. Do not add age rules until decision D6 is resolved.
arabic: شروط الأهلية المعلنة. لا تُضف قيودًا عمرية حتى يُحسم القرار D6.

key: Published points are awarded for approved results in tournaments that use this table. It replaces the current published table for this discipline and season. Publish only a table the owner has decided.
english: Published points are awarded for approved results in tournaments that use this table. It replaces the current published table for this discipline and season. Publish only a table the owner has decided.
arabic: تُمنح النقاط المنشورة عن النتائج المعتمدة في البطولات التي تستخدم هذا الجدول. وهو يحل محل الجدول المنشور الحالي لهذا التخصص والموسم. انشر فقط جدولاً قرّره المالك.

key: Published rules, including scoring and tie-breakers for this sport.
english: Published rules, including scoring and tie-breakers for this sport.
arabic: القواعد المعلنة، بما فيها احتساب النتائج وكسر التعادل لهذه الرياضة.

key: Readers can open the tournament from the article while it is public.
english: Readers can open the tournament from the article while it is public.
arabic: يمكن للقراء فتح البطولة من المقال ما دامت عامة.

key: Readers only see articles in their app language, or articles for all languages.
english: Readers only see articles in their app language, or articles for all languages.
arabic: يرى القراء فقط المقالات بلغة تطبيقهم أو المقالات المخصصة لكل اللغات.

key: Reason (required after registration opens, except to make a prize more certain)
english: Reason (required after registration opens, except to make a prize more certain)
arabic: السبب (مطلوب بعد فتح التسجيل، إلا لجعل الجائزة أكثر تأكيداً)

key: Reason for correction (required after registration opens)
english: Reason for correction (required after registration opens)

key: Record cash actually handed to the winner. Payments are not made by the app.
english: Record cash actually handed to the winner. Payments are not made by the app.
arabic: سجّل النقد الذي سُلّم فعلاً للفائز. التطبيق لا يقوم بأي دفع.

key: Record cash actually paid out. It must come from the expense fund or unrestricted money.
english: Record cash actually paid out. It must come from the expense fund or unrestricted money.
arabic: سجّل النقد المدفوع فعلاً. يجب أن يكون من صندوق المصاريف أو من المال غير المقيد.

key: Record cash handed back to the player. Received so far: :paid.
english: Record cash handed back to the player. Received so far: :paid.
arabic: سجّل المبلغ النقدي المُعاد للاعب. المستلم حتى الآن: :paid.

key: Record cash you actually handed back. Returned items in sellable condition go back into stock.
english: Record cash you actually handed back. Returned items in sellable condition go back into stock.
arabic: سجّل المبلغ النقدي الذي أعدته فعلًا. المنتجات المُرجعة الصالحة للبيع تعود إلى المخزون.

key: Record money you already paid to the seller. Nothing is transferred by RIVALO.
english: Record money you already paid to the seller. Nothing is transferred by RIVALO.
arabic: سجّل مبلغًا دفعته فعلًا للبائع. لا تحوّل RIVALO أي أموال.

key: Record open questions here (e.g. D1: exact American pool ruleset).
english: Record open questions here (e.g. D1: exact American pool ruleset).
arabic: سجّل الأسئلة المفتوحة هنا (مثل D1: قواعد البلياردو الأمريكي بالتحديد).

key: Record that :amount was received in cash and the customer has the items. A receipt number is created.
english: Record that :amount was received in cash and the customer has the items. A receipt number is created.
arabic: سجّل أن :amount استُلم نقدًا وأن العميل استلم المنتجات. يُنشأ رقم إيصال.

key: Record that :amount was received in cash. A receipt number is created.
english: Record that :amount was received in cash. A receipt number is created.
arabic: سجّل أن :amount استُلم نقدًا. يُنشأ رقم إيصال.

key: Record that the customer has the items.
english: Record that the customer has the items.

key: Record the cash payment before completing the order.
english: Record the cash payment before completing the order.
arabic: سجّل الدفع النقدي قبل إكمال الطلب.

key: Record the entry fee before checking in.
english: Record the entry fee before checking in.
arabic: سجّل رسوم الاشتراك قبل تسجيل الحضور.

key: Record this only when a qualified reviewer has approved version :v in writing. The app will stop showing "Pending legal review" for this version.
english: Record this only when a qualified reviewer has approved version :v in writing. The app will stop showing "Pending legal review" for this version.
arabic: سجّل هذا فقط عندما يوافق مراجع مؤهل كتابيًا على الإصدار :v. سيتوقف التطبيق عن عرض «بانتظار المراجعة القانونية» لهذا الإصدار.

key: Record unsold items you handed back to the seller. They leave the stock RIVALO holds.
english: Record unsold items you handed back to the seller. They leave the stock RIVALO holds.
arabic: سجّل المنتجات غير المباعة التي سلّمتها للبائع. تُخصم من المخزون الذي تحتفظ به RIVALO.

key: Recorded in the audit log with your name.
english: Recorded in the audit log with your name.

key: Registration has opened, so fees, prize rules, entry format, roster size and ranking eligibility are locked. A correction needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
english: Registration has opened, so fees, prize rules, entry format, roster size and ranking eligibility are locked. A correction needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
arabic: بدأ التسجيل، لذا أصبحت الرسوم وقواعد الجوائز وصيغة الاشتراك وحجم التشكيلة واحتساب التصنيف مقفلة. أي تصحيح يتطلب سببًا ويُسجَّل في سجل التدقيق.

key: Registration must open before it closes.
english: Registration must open before it closes.
arabic: يجب أن يُفتح التسجيل قبل أن يُغلق.

key: Registrations beyond this go to the waitlist.
english: Registrations beyond this go to the waitlist.
arabic: التسجيلات الزائدة عن هذا العدد تذهب إلى قائمة الانتظار.

key: Reminders and scheduled announcements are not being sent.
english: Reminders and scheduled announcements are not being sent.

key: Reports from players. Each decision needs a reason and is audited. Reporters are told their report was reviewed, never what happened to the other player.
english: Reports from players. Each decision needs a reason and is audited. Reporters are told their report was reviewed, never what happened to the other player.
arabic: بلاغات من اللاعبين. كل قرار يحتاج إلى سبب ويُسجَّل في سجل التدقيق. يُبلَّغ المُبلِّغ بأن بلاغه رُوجع، ولا يُبلَّغ أبدًا بما حدث للاعب الآخر.

key: Required before activating an e-sports title. Do not guess versions: enter exactly what will be played.
english: Required before activating an e-sports title. Do not guess versions: enter exactly what will be played.
arabic: مطلوب قبل تفعيل أي لعبة إلكترونية. لا تخمّن الإصدار: أدخل بالضبط ما سيُلعب.

key: Required only if you change a locked field.
english: Required only if you change a locked field.
arabic: مطلوب فقط إذا غيّرت حقلًا مقفلًا.

key: Results are already recorded, so the draw can no longer be changed.
english: Results are already recorded, so the draw can no longer be changed.
arabic: سُجّلت نتائج بالفعل، لذا لا يمكن تغيير القرعة.

key: RIVALO commission: :rate of the item price, as in your agreement.
english: RIVALO commission: :rate of the item price, as in your agreement.
arabic: عمولة RIVALO: :rate من سعر المنتج، كما في اتفاقيتك.

key: RIVALO owes them for completed sales. Record each payout after you pay.
english: RIVALO owes them for completed sales. Record each payout after you pay.
arabic: على RIVALO مبالغ لهم عن مبيعات مكتملة. سجّل كل دفعة بعد الدفع.

key: RIVALO owes this seller :owed. A payout cannot be more than that.
english: RIVALO owes this seller :owed. A payout cannot be more than that.
arabic: المستحق لهذا البائع على RIVALO هو :owed. لا يمكن أن تتجاوز الدفعة ذلك.

key: RIVALO owes you :owed. Sales :sales, commission :commission, returns :returns, adjustments :adjustments, paid to you :paid.
english: RIVALO owes you :owed. Sales :sales, commission :commission, returns :returns, adjustments :adjustments, paid to you :paid.
arabic: المستحق لك على RIVALO: :owed. المبيعات :sales، العمولة :commission، المرتجعات :returns، التسويات :adjustments، المدفوع لك :paid.

key: RIVALO pays you in cash or by bank transfer and records each payout on your statement. Nothing is paid automatically.
english: RIVALO pays you in cash or by bank transfer and records each payout on your statement. Nothing is paid automatically.
arabic: تدفع لك RIVALO نقدًا أو بتحويل مصرفي وتسجّل كل دفعة في كشف حسابك. لا يُدفع أي شيء تلقائيًا.

key: RIVALO staff check the product, photos and price. You get a message when it is on sale or if changes are needed.
english: RIVALO staff check the product, photos and price. You get a message when it is on sale or if changes are needed.
arabic: يراجع موظفو RIVALO المنتج والصور والسعر. تصلك رسالة عند عرضه للبيع أو إذا لزمت تعديلات.

key: Roster minimum must be at least 1 and not exceed roster maximum.
english: Roster minimum must be at least 1 and not exceed roster maximum.
arabic: يجب ألا يقل الحد الأدنى للتشكيلة عن 1 وألا يتجاوز الحد الأقصى.

key: Sales appear here when the customer has the item and has paid.
english: Sales appear here when the customer has the item and has paid.
arabic: تظهر المبيعات هنا عندما يستلم العميل المنتج ويدفع ثمنه.

key: Scan the player's QR code with your phone camera, type the code, or choose a tournament and search.
english: Scan the player's QR code with your phone camera, type the code, or choose a tournament and search.
arabic: امسح رمز QR الخاص باللاعب بكاميرا هاتفك، أو اكتب الرمز، أو اختر بطولة وابحث.

key: Seller product: use Approve or Request changes above.
english: Seller product: use Approve or Request changes above.
arabic: منتج بائع: استخدم «اعتماد» أو «طلب تعديلات» في الأعلى.

key: Set both the prize pool share and the organizer share before approving.
english: Set both the prize pool share and the organizer share before approving.
arabic: حدّد حصة مجموع الجوائز وحصة المنظم قبل الموافقة.
يجب أن تكون الحصص بين 0% و100%.

key: Shares of net entry revenue (entry fees received minus refunds).
english: Shares of net entry revenue (entry fees received minus refunds).
arabic: حصص من صافي إيراد الاشتراكات (الرسوم المستلمة ناقص المبالغ المستردة).

key: Shares of net entry revenue (entry fees received minus refunds). Saving always returns the rules to Draft until they are approved again.
english: Shares of net entry revenue (entry fees received minus refunds). Saving always returns the rules to Draft until they are approved again.
arabic: حصص من صافي إيراد الاشتراكات (الرسوم المستلمة ناقص المبالغ المستردة). الحفظ يعيد القواعد دائماً إلى مسودة حتى تتم الموافقة عليها مجدداً.

key: Shop name shown in the app
english: Shop name shown in the app

arabic: صفحة المتجر أو الحساب على مواقع التواصل

key: Shown in the app as a draft. Needed before public launch (D6).
english: Shown in the app as a draft. Needed before public launch (D6).
arabic: تظهر في التطبيق كمسودة. مطلوبة قبل الإطلاق العام (D6).

key: Shown in their inbox. Leave empty for the standard text pointing to the community guidelines.
english: Shown in their inbox. Leave empty for the standard text pointing to the community guidelines.
arabic: تظهر في صندوق الوارد لديه. اتركها فارغة لاستخدام النص المعتاد الذي يشير إلى إرشادات المجتمع.

key: Some emails or phone notifications were not sent. Run php artisan queue:failed on the server.
english: Some emails or phone notifications were not sent. Run php artisan queue:failed on the server.
arabic: لم تُرسل بعض الرسائل الإلكترونية أو إشعارات الهاتف. شغّل php artisan queue:failed على الخادم.

key: Stable identifier used by the app. Avoid changing after launch.
english: Stable identifier used by the app. Avoid changing after launch.
arabic: معرّف ثابت يستخدمه التطبيق. تجنّب تغييره بعد الإطلاق.

key: Staff roles require an authenticator app (MFA) at the next admin sign-in.
english: Staff roles require an authenticator app (MFA) at the next admin sign-in.
arabic: أدوار الموظفين تتطلب تطبيق مصادقة (المصادقة الثنائية) عند تسجيل الدخول التالي.

key: Stock is what RIVALO holds for you. Staff count it in when you bring it.
english: Stock is what RIVALO holds for you. Staff count it in when you bring it.
arabic: المخزون هو ما تحتفظ به RIVALO لك. يعدّه الموظفون عند إحضارك له.

key: Suspension blocks sign-in and revokes app sessions. Deletion uses the player-initiated workflow.
english: Suspension blocks sign-in and revokes app sessions. Deletion uses the player-initiated workflow.
arabic: الإيقاف يمنع تسجيل الدخول وينهي جلسات التطبيق. الحذف يتم عبر طلب اللاعب نفسه.

key: Terms and Privacy show "Pending legal review" in the app until a super admin records that a qualified reviewer approved the live version.
english: Terms and Privacy show "Pending legal review" in the app until a super admin records that a qualified reviewer approved the live version.
arabic: تظهر الشروط والخصوصية في التطبيق بعبارة «بانتظار المراجعة القانونية» حتى يسجّل مدير عام أن مراجعًا مؤهلًا وافق على الإصدار المنشور.

key: The amount must be more than 0 and at most the :remaining still expected. Add a new contribution for extra money.
english: The amount must be more than 0 and at most the :remaining still expected. Add a new contribution for extra money.
arabic: يجب أن يكون المبلغ أكبر من 0 وألا يتجاوز :remaining المتبقي المتوقع. أضف مساهمة جديدة لأي مبلغ إضافي.

key: The amount must be more than 0.
english: The amount must be more than 0.
arabic: يجب أن يكون المبلغ أكبر من 0.

key: The amount must equal the entry fee of :fee.
english: The amount must equal the entry fee of :fee.
arabic: يجب أن يساوي المبلغ رسوم الاشتراك البالغة :fee.

key: The applicant was told in the app.
english: The applicant was told in the app.
arabic: تم إبلاغ مقدّم الطلب في التطبيق.

key: The cash amount must be more than 0.
english: The cash amount must be more than 0.
arabic: يجب أن يكون المبلغ النقدي أكبر من 0.

key: The customer gets a message that the order is on its way.
english: The customer gets a message that the order is on its way.
arabic: يتلقى العميل رسالة بأن الطلب في الطريق.

key: The customer gets a message that the order is ready to collect.
english: The customer gets a message that the order is ready to collect.
arabic: يتلقى العميل رسالة بأن الطلب جاهز للاستلام.

key: The discipline does not belong to the selected sport.
english: The discipline does not belong to the selected sport.

key: The discipline must be active with a confirmed ruleset before the tournament can be published.
english: The discipline must be active with a confirmed ruleset before the tournament can be published.
arabic: يجب أن تكون الفئة نشطة وقواعدها مؤكدة قبل نشر البطولة.

key: The draft has changes players do not see yet.
english: The draft has changes players do not see yet.
arabic: في المسودة تغييرات لا يراها اللاعبون بعد.

key: The English title and text are required.
english: The English title and text are required.

key: The finance rules are still a draft. Approve them before paying the organizer share.
english: The finance rules are still a draft. Approve them before paying the organizer share.
arabic: القواعد المالية ما زالت مسودة. وافق عليها قبل دفع حصة المنظم.

key: The first waitlisted entry is promoted automatically. Record any in-person refund separately.
english: The first waitlisted entry is promoted automatically. Record any in-person refund separately.
arabic: يُرفَّع أول مسجّل في قائمة الانتظار تلقائيًا. سجّل أي استرداد حضوري بشكل منفصل.

key: The image could not be read.
english: The image could not be read.

key: The items go back into stock and the customer is told the reason.
english: The items go back into stock and the customer is told the reason.
arabic: تعود المنتجات إلى المخزون ويُبلَّغ العميل بالسبب.

key: The old result is kept as superseded, its points are reversed, and the bracket is updated. Not possible once a later match that depends on it has been played.
english: The old result is kept as superseded, its points are reversed, and the bracket is updated. Not possible once a later match that depends on it has been played.
arabic: تُحفظ النتيجة القديمة كمستبدلة، وتُعكس نقاطها، ويُحدَّث جدول خروج المغلوب. غير ممكن بعد لعب مباراة لاحقة تعتمد عليها.

key: The organizer can only be paid from organizer or unrestricted money. Prize-only and expense money can never fund the organizer.
english: The organizer can only be paid from organizer or unrestricted money. Prize-only and expense money can never fund the organizer.
arabic: لا يُدفع للمنظم إلا من صندوق المنظم أو من المال غير المقيد. أموال الجوائز والمصاريف لا تموّل المنظم أبداً.

key: The payment date cannot be in the future.
english: The payment date cannot be in the future.
arabic: لا يمكن أن يكون تاريخ الدفع في المستقبل.

key: The payment for this order is already recorded.
english: The payment for this order is already recorded.

key: The player is told what was removed. Other open reports about the same subject are closed with this decision.
english: The player is told what was removed. Other open reports about the same subject are closed with this decision.
arabic: يُبلَّغ اللاعب بما أُزيل. تُغلق البلاغات المفتوحة الأخرى عن الموضوع نفسه بهذا القرار.

key: The points table must be for this tournament's discipline and season.
english: The points table must be for this tournament's discipline and season.
arabic: يجب أن يكون جدول النقاط لتخصص هذه البطولة وموسمها.

key: The prize pool and organizer share together cannot exceed 100% of net entry revenue.
english: The prize pool and organizer share together cannot exceed 100% of net entry revenue.
arabic: لا يمكن أن تتجاوز حصة مجموع الجوائز وحصة المنظم معاً 100% من صافي إيراد الاشتراكات.

key: The product goes on sale once stock is recorded. Check the name, photos, description and price first.
english: The product goes on sale once stock is recorded. Check the name, photos, description and price first.
arabic: يُعرض المنتج للبيع بعد تسجيل المخزون. تحقّق أولًا من الاسم والصور والوصف والسعر.

key: The product is no longer offered. Its sales and statement lines stay.
english: The product is no longer offered. Its sales and statement lines stay.
arabic: لن يُعرض المنتج بعد الآن. تبقى مبيعاته وبنود كشف الحساب الخاصة به.

key: The product leaves the store until RIVALO approves it again. Orders already placed are not affected.
english: The product leaves the store until RIVALO approves it again. Orders already placed are not affected.
arabic: يُسحب المنتج من المتجر حتى تعتمده RIVALO مرة أخرى. لا تتأثر الطلبات السابقة.

key: The refund must be between 0 and :max.
english: The refund must be between 0 and :max.
arabic: يجب أن يكون الاسترداد بين 0 و:max.

key: The refund must be more than 0 and at most the :paid received.
english: The refund must be more than 0 and at most the :paid received.
arabic: يجب أن يكون الاسترداد أكبر من 0 وألا يتجاوز :paid المستلمة.

key: The seller was told in the app.
english: The seller was told in the app.

key: The shop's products leave the store at once. Orders already placed continue. The seller can still read their statement.
english: The shop's products leave the store at once. Orders already placed continue. The seller can still read their statement.
arabic: تُسحب منتجات المتجر من المتجر فورًا. تستمر الطلبات السابقة، ويبقى بإمكان البائع قراءة كشف حسابه.

key: The tournament must start before it ends.
english: The tournament must start before it ends.
arabic: يجب أن تبدأ البطولة قبل أن تنتهي.

key: The user must enroll a new authenticator app at their next admin sign-in. Verify their identity out-of-band first.
english: The user must enroll a new authenticator app at their next admin sign-in. Verify their identity out-of-band first.
arabic: سيتعيّن على المستخدم تسجيل تطبيق مصادقة جديد عند دخوله التالي. تحقّق من هويته بوسيلة أخرى أولًا.

key: There are no draft fixtures to publish.
english: There are no draft fixtures to publish.

key: There is already a prize for this place.
english: There is already a prize for this place.

key: This check-in code is not valid.
english: This check-in code is not valid.
arabic: رمز تسجيل الحضور هذا غير صالح.

key: This code belongs to a different entry.
english: This code belongs to a different entry.

key: This discipline does not allow that registration type.
english: This discipline does not allow that registration type.
arabic: هذه الفئة لا تسمح بنوع التسجيل هذا.

key: This entry is not checked in.
english: This entry is not checked in.

key: This is an official RIVALO product. Edit its status directly.
english: This is an official RIVALO product. Edit its status directly.
arabic: هذا منتج رسمي من RIVALO. عدّل حالته مباشرة.

key: This is more than the organizer share still due (:remaining).
english: This is more than the organizer share still due (:remaining).
arabic: هذا أكثر من حصة المنظم المتبقية (:remaining).

key: This is more than the prize amount still due (:remaining).
english: This is more than the prize amount still due (:remaining).
arabic: هذا أكثر من مبلغ الجائزة المتبقي (:remaining).

key: This money has already been used. Reverse the later entries first.
english: This money has already been used. Reverse the later entries first.
arabic: هذا المال استُخدم بالفعل. اعكس القيود اللاحقة أولاً.

key: This order is :status and cannot be moved to :next.
english: This order is :status and cannot be moved to :next.
arabic: هذا الطلب :status ولا يمكن نقله إلى :next.

key: This order is for delivery. Mark it out for delivery instead.
english: This order is for delivery. Mark it out for delivery instead.
arabic: هذا الطلب للتوصيل. حدّده كـ«في الطريق للتوصيل» بدلًا من ذلك.

key: This order is for pickup. Mark it ready for pickup instead.
english: This order is for pickup. Mark it ready for pickup instead.
arabic: هذا الطلب للاستلام. حدّده كـ«جاهز للاستلام» بدلًا من ذلك.

key: This page does not need a legal review.
english: This page does not need a legal review.
arabic: هذه الصفحة لا تحتاج إلى مراجعة قانونية.

key: This player already has this badge.
english: This player already has this badge.
arabic: هذا اللاعب يملك هذا الوسام بالفعل.

key: This player is no longer on an active entry for this tournament.
english: This player is no longer on an active entry for this tournament.
arabic: لم يعد هذا اللاعب ضمن اشتراك نشط في هذه البطولة.

key: This prize has no cash amount to pay.
english: This prize has no cash amount to pay.
arabic: لا يوجد مبلغ نقدي لهذه الجائزة.

key: This prize has payout records and cannot be removed.
english: This prize has payout records and cannot be removed.
arabic: لهذه الجائزة سجلات دفع ولا يمكن إزالتها.

key: This prize is still an estimate. Finalize it before paying.
english: This prize is still an estimate. Finalize it before paying.
arabic: هذه الجائزة ما زالت تقديرية. اجعلها نهائية قبل الدفع.

key: This sends the saved version to :count people. It cannot be unsent.
english: This sends the saved version to :count people. It cannot be unsent.
arabic: سيُرسل النسخة المحفوظة إلى :count شخص. لا يمكن التراجع عن الإرسال.

key: This tournament does not count toward rankings.
english: This tournament does not count toward rankings.
arabic: هذه البطولة لا تُحتسب في الترتيب.

key: This tournament has no group stage.
english: This tournament has no group stage.
arabic: هذه البطولة ليس لها دور مجموعات.

key: This tournament is free. No payment is needed.
english: This tournament is free. No payment is needed.
arabic: هذه البطولة مجانية. لا حاجة إلى دفع.

key: This user does not hold a role that allows the :role assignment.
english: This user does not hold a role that allows the :role assignment.
arabic: لا يملك هذا المستخدم دورًا يسمح بتعيينه «:role».

key: To bring more stock, or to take unsold items back, contact RIVALO. Staff record every change here.
english: To bring more stock, or to take unsold items back, contact RIVALO. Staff record every change here.
arabic: لإحضار مخزون إضافي أو استرداد منتجات غير مباعة تواصل مع RIVALO. يسجّل الموظفون كل تغيير هنا.
لتغيير هذه البيانات تواصل مع RIVALO.

key: Tournaments can only be published on disciplines with a confirmed ruleset.
english: Tournaments can only be published on disciplines with a confirmed ruleset.
arabic: لا يمكن نشر البطولات إلا في فئات قواعدها مؤكدة.

key: Turn on only when the sponsor has agreed to be shown. Amounts are never shown.
english: Turn on only when the sponsor has agreed to be shown. Amounts are never shown.
arabic: فعّله فقط عندما يوافق الراعي على الظهور. المبالغ لا تُعرض أبداً.

key: Unrestricted money can be set aside for prizes, expenses or the organizer.
english: Unrestricted money can be set aside for prizes, expenses or the organizer.
arabic: يمكن تخصيص المال غير المقيد للجوائز أو المصاريف أو المنظم.

key: Use "New version" to change a published table. Tournaments keep the table they were assigned.
english: Use "New version" to change a published table. Tournaments keep the table they were assigned.
arabic: استخدم "نسخة جديدة" لتغيير جدول منشور. تحتفظ البطولات بالجدول المعيّن لها.

key: Use after a stock count, or for damaged or lost items. The difference is recorded with your reason.
english: Use after a stock count, or for damaged or lost items. The difference is recorded with your reason.
arabic: استخدمه بعد الجرد أو للمنتجات التالفة أو المفقودة. يُسجَّل الفرق مع السبب.

key: Use only a logo the sponsor has provided or approved.
english: Use only a logo the sponsor has provided or approved.
arabic: استخدم فقط شعاراً قدّمه الراعي أو وافق عليه.

key: Use only photos you own or have permission to publish. Without a photo the app shows sport artwork.
english: Use only photos you own or have permission to publish. Without a photo the app shows sport artwork.
arabic: استخدم فقط صوراً تملكها أو لديك إذن بنشرها. بدون صورة يعرض التطبيق رسماً خاصاً بالرياضة.

key: Use only photos you own. The first photo is the main one.
english: Use only photos you own. The first photo is the main one.
arabic: استخدم صورًا تملكها فقط. الصورة الأولى هي الرئيسية.

key: Use only when the captain is unreachable or has left. The change and reason are audited.
english: Use only when the captain is unreachable or has left. The change and reason are audited.
arabic: استخدمه فقط إذا تعذّر الوصول إلى القائد أو غادر. يُسجَّل التغيير وسببه في التدقيق.

key: Use this to correct a mistake. The record stays in history, marked void.
english: Use this to correct a mistake. The record stays in history, marked void.
arabic: استخدم هذا لتصحيح خطأ. يبقى السجل في التاريخ موسومًا بأنه ملغى.

key: Uses checked-in, eligible entrants. Seeded entrants are placed first; the rest are drawn at random. The draw number lets anyone reproduce the draw. A draw can be redone until the first result is entered.
english: Uses checked-in, eligible entrants. Seeded entrants are placed first; the rest are drawn at random. The draw number lets anyone reproduce the draw. A draw can be redone until the first result is entered.
arabic: تستخدم المشاركين المؤهلين الذين سجّلوا حضورهم. يوضع المصنّفون أولاً، ويُسحب الباقون عشوائياً. رقم القرعة يتيح لأي أحد إعادة إنتاجها. يمكن إعادة القرعة حتى إدخال أول نتيجة.

key: Void the refunds for this entry before voiding its payment.
english: Void the refunds for this entry before voiding its payment.
arabic: ألغِ الاستردادات لهذا الاشتراك قبل إلغاء دفعته.

key: What the profile or team looked like at the time. It may have changed since.
english: What the profile or team looked like at the time. It may have changed since.
arabic: كيف بدا الملف الشخصي أو الفريق وقتها. ربما تغيّر منذ ذلك الحين.
ما الذي يجب على البائع تعديله

key: When an order is completed, the item price minus the commission is added to your statement. Returns are taken off again.
english: When an order is completed, the item price minus the commission is added to your statement. Returns are taken off again.
arabic: عند اكتمال الطلب يُضاف سعر المنتج بعد خصم العمولة إلى كشف حسابك. وتُخصم المرتجعات لاحقًا.

key: Where the owner's decision is documented (decision D3).
english: Where the owner's decision is documented (decision D3).

key: You are not assigned to check in entrants for this tournament.
english: You are not assigned to check in entrants for this tournament.
arabic: لست معيّنًا لتسجيل حضور المشاركين في هذه البطولة.

key: You are not assigned to this tournament for this task.
english: You are not assigned to this tournament for this task.
arabic: لست معيّنًا لهذه المهمة في هذه البطولة.

key: Your email address is not verified.
english: Your email address is not verified.

key: Your own code for this size. It is printed on RIVALO's stock records.
english: Your own code for this size. It is printed on RIVALO's stock records.
arabic: رمزك الخاص لهذا المقاس. يُطبع في سجلات مخزون RIVALO.

key: Your shop is :status. Your products are not shown in the store.
english: Your shop is :status. Your products are not shown in the store.
arabic: متجرك :status. منتجاتك لا تظهر في المتجر.

english: You need an account to do this.
kurdish: Ji bo vê yekê hesabek pêwîst e.

english: You need an account to receive team invitations.
arabic: تحتاج إلى حساب لتلقي دعوات الفرق.
kurdish: Ji bo wergirtina vexwendinên tîmê hesabek pêwîst e.

english: You need an account to register for tournaments.
arabic: تحتاج إلى حساب للتسجيل في البطولات.
kurdish: Ji bo tomarbûna di tûrnûvayan de hesabek pêwîst e.

english: You need an account to create or join teams.
arabic: تحتاج إلى حساب لإنشاء الفرق أو الانضمام إليها.
kurdish: Ji bo çêkirin an tevlîbûna tîman hesabek pêwîst e.

english: Badges come only from approved results, final placements and venue check-ins.
arabic: تأتي الأوسمة فقط من النتائج المعتمدة والترتيب النهائي وتسجيل الحضور.
kurdish: Nîşan tenê ji encamên pejirandî, rêzbendiya dawî û amadebûna li cih tên.

english: Add jerseys, apparel or equipment from the store.
arabic: أضف قمصانًا أو ملابس أو معدات من المتجر.
kurdish: Ji firotgehê kiras, cil an alavan zêde bike.

english: Something in your bag changed. Update or remove it first.
arabic: تغيّر شيء في حقيبتك. حدّثه أو أزله أولًا.
kurdish: Tiştek di çenteyê te de guherî. Pêşî wê nû bike an rake.

english: {count, plural, =0{Sold out} =1{Only 1 left: lower the quantity} other{Only {count} left: lower the quantity}}
arabic: {count, plural, =0{نفدت الكمية} =1{بقيت قطعة واحدة فقط: قلّل الكمية} other{بقي {count} فقط: قلّل الكمية}}
kurdish: {count, plural, =0{Qediya} =1{Tenê 1 maye: hejmarê kêm bike} other{Tenê {count} mane: hejmarê kêm bike}}

english: You won't find each other in search and can't invite each other to teams. They are not told. You can still play in the same tournaments.
arabic: لن تجدا بعضكما في البحث ولن تتمكنا من دعوة بعضكما إلى الفرق. لن يُبلَّغ بذلك. لا يزال بإمكانكما اللعب في البطولات نفسها.
kurdish: Hûn ê di lêgerînê de hev nebînin û nikarin hev vexwînin tîman. Ji wî re nayê gotin. Hûn hîn jî dikarin di heman tûrnûvayan de bilîzin.

english: Blocked players don't see you in search and can't invite you to teams. They are not told.
arabic: اللاعبون المحظورون لا يرونك في البحث ولا يمكنهم دعوتك إلى الفرق. لا يُبلَّغون بذلك.
kurdish: Lîstikvanên astengkirî te di lêgerînê de nabînin û nikarin te vexwînin tîman. Ji wan re nayê gotin.

english: If the code won't scan, turn up your screen brightness.
arabic: إذا تعذّر مسح الرمز، ارفع سطوع الشاشة.
kurdish: Heke kod neyê xwendin, ronahiya ekranê zêde bike.

english: Show this code at the venue. Staff confirm your identity, record any entry fee in person, and check you in.
arabic: اعرض هذا الرمز في مكان البطولة. يتحقق الموظفون من هويتك ويسجّلون أي رسوم حضوريًا ثم يسجّلون حضورك.
kurdish: Vê kodê li cihê tûrnûvayê nîşan bide. Karmend nasnameya te piştrast dikin, heqê beşdariyê li cih tomar dikin û amadebûna te tomar dikin.

english: Showing the copy saved on this device. Your status may be out of date.
arabic: يتم عرض النسخة المحفوظة على هذا الجهاز. قد تكون حالتك غير محدثة.
kurdish: Kopiya ku li ser vê cîhazê hatiye tomarkirin tê nîşandan. Dibe ku rewşa te ne nû be.
Koda QR ya amadebûnê ji bo {name}

english: Street, building, landmark. Only the store team sees it.
arabic: الشارع، المبنى، معلم قريب. لا يراه إلا فريق المتجر.
kurdish: Kolan, avahî, nîşaneyek. Tenê tîma firotgehê wê dibîne.

english: Choose where to collect your order.
kurdish: Hilbijêre fermana xwe li ku werdigirî.

english: Enter the name, phone number and address for delivery.
arabic: أدخل الاسم ورقم الهاتف والعنوان للتوصيل.
kurdish: Ji bo gihandinê nav, hejmara telefonê û navnîşanê binivîse.

english: We deliver only to these areas. The fee is added to your total.
arabic: نوصل إلى هذه المناطق فقط. تُضاف الرسوم إلى المجموع.
kurdish: Em tenê digihînin van herêman. Heq li ser berhevokê tê zêdekirin.

english: Delivery is not available yet. Choose pickup.
arabic: التوصيل غير متاح بعد. اختر الاستلام.
kurdish: Gihandin hîn ne berdest e. Wergirtinê hilbijêre.

english: You pay {amount} in cash when you receive your order. Nothing is charged now.
arabic: تدفع {amount} نقدًا عند استلام طلبك. لا يُخصم أي مبلغ الآن.
kurdish: Dema ku tu fermana xwe distînî {amount} bi kaş didî. Niha tiştek nayê girtin.

english: We tell you in your inbox when your order is ready.
arabic: سنخبرك في صندوق الوارد عندما يصبح طلبك جاهزًا.
kurdish: Dema ku fermana te amade be, em ê di sindoqa te de ji te re bibêjin.

english: Your account will be deleted after a {days}-day grace period. Sign in and cancel anytime before then. Personal data is removed; approved tournament results remain and show "Deleted player".
arabic: سيُحذف حسابك بعد فترة سماح مدتها {days} يومًا. سجّل الدخول وألغِ الحذف في أي وقت قبل ذلك. تُزال البيانات الشخصية، وتبقى نتائج البطولات المعتمدة باسم «لاعب محذوف».
kurdish: Hesabê te piştî demeke mohletê ya {days} rojan dê were jêbirin. Têkeve û heta wê demê her dem dikarî betal bikî. Daneyên kesane tên rakirin; encamên tûrnûvayan ên pejirandî dimînin û wekî «Lîstikvanê jêbirî» xuya dibin.

english: Deletion cancelled. Your account stays active.
kurdish: Jêbirin hat betalkirin. Hesabê te çalak dimîne.

english: Fixtures and the bracket will appear here after the draw.
arabic: ستظهر المباريات وشجرة البطولة هنا بعد القرعة.
kurdish: Maç û darê tûrnûvayê piştî kişandinê dê li vir xuya bibin.

english: Entry fees are paid in person at the venue to authorized staff. There is no payment in the app.
arabic: تُدفع رسوم المشاركة شخصيًا في المكان لموظفين مخوّلين. لا يوجد دفع داخل التطبيق.
kurdish: Heqê beşdarbûnê li cih ji karmendên destûrdar re tê dayîn. Di sepanê de dayîn tune.

english: Counts toward rankings once points rules are published
arabic: تُحتسب في التصنيف بعد نشر قواعد النقاط
kurdish: Piştî weşandina rêgezên xalan di rêzbendiyê de tê hesibandin

english: These rules are locked. Any correction is published with a reason.
arabic: هذه القواعد مقفلة. يُنشر أي تصحيح مع سببه.
kurdish: Ev rêgez hatine qefilandin. Her rastkirinek bi sedemê xwe tê weşandin.

english: Times are shown in your device's time zone.
arabic: الأوقات معروضة حسب المنطقة الزمنية لجهازك.
kurdish: Dem li gorî demjimêra cîhaza te tên nîşandan.
Ji bo tomarbûnê e-nameya xwe piştrast bike

english: Shown on your public profile if you allow it.
arabic: يظهر في ملفك العام إذا سمحت بذلك.
kurdish: Heke tu destûrê bidî, li ser profîla te ya giştî xuya dibe.

arabic: {count, plural, =1{يوم واحد} =2{يومين} few{{count} أيام} other{{count} يومًا}}

english: Private. Used for sign-in and important account messages.
arabic: خاص. يُستخدم لتسجيل الدخول ورسائل الحساب المهمة.
kurdish: Taybet e. Ji bo têketinê û peyamên girîng ên hesabê.

english: Your place will be offered to the next entrant on the waitlist.
arabic: سيُعرض مكانك على المشارك التالي في قائمة الانتظار.
kurdish: Cihê te dê ji beşdarê din ê lîsteya bendemayînê re were pêşkêşkirin.

english: Next: check in with staff at the venue before check-in closes.
arabic: التالي: سجّل حضورك لدى الموظفين في المكان قبل انتهاء تسجيل الحضور.
kurdish: Paşê: berî girtina amadebûnê li cih bi karmendan re amadebûna xwe tomar bike.

english: Next: pay {fee} in person and check in with staff before check-in closes.
arabic: التالي: ادفع {fee} شخصيًا وسجّل حضورك لدى الموظفين قبل انتهاء تسجيل الحضور.
kurdish: Paşê: {fee} li cih bide û berî girtina amadebûnê bi karmendan re amadebûna xwe tomar bike.

english: Please try again. If the problem continues, contact support.
arabic: يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى. إذا استمرت المشكلة، تواصل مع الدعم.
kurdish: Ji kerema xwe dîsa biceribîne. Heke pirsgirêk berdewam bike, bi piştgiriyê re têkilî dayne.

english: This item is no longer available.
Check your connection and try again.
arabic: تحقق من اتصالك وحاول مرة أخرى.
kurdish: Girêdana xwe kontrol bike û dîsa biceribîne.

english: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
arabic: محاولات كثيرة جدًا. انتظر دقيقة ثم حاول مرة أخرى.
kurdish: Hewldan pir zêde ne. Deqeyekê bisekine û dîsa biceribîne.

english: Fixtures appear here after the draw.
kurdish: Maç piştî kişandinê li vir xuya dibin.

english: No ranking points are awarded in this tournament.
arabic: لا تُمنح نقاط ترتيب في هذه البطولة.
kurdish: Di vê tûrnûvayê de xalên rêzbendiyê nayên dayîn.

english: Enter your account email. If an account exists, we'll send a link to choose a new password.
arabic: أدخل البريد الإلكتروني لحسابك. إذا كان الحساب موجودًا، سنرسل رابطًا لاختيار كلمة مرور جديدة.
kurdish: E-nameya hesabê xwe binivîse. Heke hesab hebe, em ê girêdanekê ji bo hilbijartina şîfreyeke nû bişînin.

english: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
arabic: إذا كان هناك حساب بهذا البريد، فرابط إعادة التعيين في طريقه إليك.
kurdish: Heke hesabek bi vê e-nameyê hebe, girêdana nûkirinê di rê de ye.
Lîg (her kes li dijî her kesî)
Ji encamên pejirandî xalan bi dest bixe
Profîla xwe ya giştî ava bike
Tîman çêke û tevlî wan bibe

english: Look around tournaments, rankings and player profiles. Create a free account to register, join teams and earn points.
arabic: تصفح البطولات والتصنيفات وملفات اللاعبين. أنشئ حسابًا مجانيًا للتسجيل والانضمام إلى الفرق وكسب النقاط.
kurdish: Li tûrnûva, rêzbendî û profîlên lîstikvanan binêre. Hesabekî belaş çêke da ku tomar bibî, tevlî tîman bibî û xalan bi dest bixî.

english: Already have an account? Sign in
New tournaments for your sports will appear here.
kurdish: Tûrnûvayên nû yên werzîşên te dê li vir xuya bibin.

english: {count, plural, =1{1 pending invitation} other{{count} pending invitations}}
arabic: {count, plural, =1{دعوة واحدة معلّقة} =2{دعوتان معلّقتان} few{{count} دعوات معلّقة} other{{count} دعوة معلّقة}}
kurdish: {count, plural, =1{1 vexwendin li bendê ye} other{{count} vexwendin li bendê ne}}

english: Select what you play to see relevant tournaments.
arabic: حدّد ما تلعبه لترى البطولات المناسبة لك.
kurdish: Tiştê ku tu dilîzî hilbijêre da ku tûrnûvayên guncav bibînî.

english: You haven't registered for a tournament yet.
arabic: لم تسجّل في أي بطولة بعد.
kurdish: Te hîn xwe di tûrnûvayekê de tomar nekiriye.
Cih tije dibin. Cihê xwe bigire.

english: Team invitations and captaincy nominations appear here.
arabic: ستظهر هنا الدعوات والنتائج والتذكيرات والإعلانات.
kurdish: Vexwendin, encam, bîranîn û ragihandin dê li vir xuya bibin.

english: Arabic translation is a draft pending native-speaker review.
arabic: الترجمة العربية مسودة بانتظار مراجعة متحدث أصلي.
kurdish: Wergera erebî reşnivîs e û divê axêverekî zikmakî lê binêre.

english: Kurdish (Kurmanji) translation is a draft pending native-speaker review.
arabic: الترجمة الكردية (الكرمانجية) مسودة بانتظار مراجعة متحدث أصلي.
kurdish: Wergera kurdî (kurmancî) reşnivîs e û divê axêverekî zikmakî lê binêre.
Ji aliyê hakem ve hat pejirandin.
Li dijî vê encamê îtîraz bike

english: Your dispute is being reviewed by a referee.
kurdish: Îtîraza te ji aliyê hakem ve tê nirxandin.

english: What is wrong with the result?
kurdish: Çi di encamê de şaş e?

english: Dispute sent. A referee will review it.
kurdish: Îtîraz hat şandin. Hakem dê lê binêre.

english: You can dispute within {hours} hours of approval.
arabic: يمكنك الاعتراض خلال {hours} ساعة من الاعتماد.
kurdish: Tu dikarî di nav {hours} saetan de piştî pejirandinê îtîraz bikî.

english: Result sent: {score}. Waiting for the referee.
kurdish: Encam hat şandin: {score}. Li benda hakem e.

english: A result was sent: {score}. A referee will review it.
kurdish: Encamek hat şandin: {score}. Hakem dê lê binêre.

english: Tournament recaps, announcements and community stories will appear here.
arabic: ستظهر هنا ملخصات البطولات والإعلانات وقصص المجتمع.
kurdish: Kurteyên tûrnûvayan, daxuyanî û çîrokên civakê dê li vir xuya bibin.

english: Announcements and tournament updates will appear here.
kurdish: Ragihandin û nûkirinên tûrnûvayan dê li vir xuya bibin.

english: New to RIVALO? Create an account
kurdish: Nû yî li RIVALO? Hesab çêke

english: Invitations, results, reminders and announcements will appear here.
arabic: ستظهر هنا الدعوات والنتائج والتذكيرات والإعلانات.
kurdish: Vexwendin, encam, bîranîn û ragihandin dê li vir xuya bibin.

english: Everything also arrives in your in-app inbox. These switches control phone notifications only.
arabic: يصل كل شيء أيضاً إلى صندوق الوارد في التطبيق. هذه المفاتيح تتحكم في إشعارات الهاتف فقط.
kurdish: Her tişt di qutiya agahdariyê ya sepanê de jî tê. Ev biryar tenê agahdariyên telefonê kontrol dikin.
Tûrnûvayên nû ji bo werzîşên min

english: You're offline. Some information may be out of date.
arabic: أنت غير متصل. قد تكون بعض المعلومات غير محدثة.
