kurdish: Tu ne girêdayî înternetê yî. Dibe ku hin agahî ne nû bin.

english: Choose your sports and games to see relevant tournaments. You can change this anytime.
arabic: اختر رياضاتك وألعابك لترى البطولات المناسبة لك. يمكنك تغيير ذلك في أي وقت.
kurdish: Werzîş û lîstikên xwe hilbijêre da ku tûrnûvayên guncav bibînî. Tu dikarî her dem vê biguherînî.

arabic: {count, plural, =0{لم يتم اختيار شيء} =1{تم اختيار واحد} other{تم اختيار {count}}}
kurdish: {count, plural, =0{Tiştek nehatiye hilbijartin} =1{1 hat hilbijartin} other{{count} hatin hilbijartin}}

english: The items go back on sale. You can order again later.
arabic: ستعود المنتجات للبيع. يمكنك الطلب مرة أخرى لاحقًا.
kurdish: Berhem dîsa ji bo firotinê vedigerin. Tu dikarî paşê dîsa ferman bidî.

english: We will tell you in your inbox when it is on its way. Pay in cash on delivery.
arabic: سنخبرك في صندوق الوارد عندما يكون في الطريق. ادفع نقدًا عند التوصيل.
kurdish: Dema ku di rê de be em ê di sindoqa te de ji te re bibêjin. Dema gihandinê bi kaş bide.

english: We will tell you in your inbox when it is ready to collect. Pay in cash on pickup.
arabic: سنخبرك في صندوق الوارد عندما يصبح جاهزًا للاستلام. ادفع نقدًا عند الاستلام.
kurdish: Dema ku ji bo wergirtinê amade be em ê di sindoqa te de ji te re bibêjin. Dema wergirtinê bi kaş bide.

english: Orders you place in the store appear here.
arabic: تظهر هنا الطلبات التي تقدمها في المتجر.
kurdish: Fermanên ku tu di firotgehê de didî li vir xuya dibin.

english: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
arabic: تم تغيير كلمة المرور. سُجّل الخروج من الأجهزة الأخرى.
kurdish: Şîfre hat guhertin. Amûrên din hatin derxistin.

english: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
arabic: 10 أحرف على الأقل، تتضمن أحرفًا وأرقامًا.
kurdish: Herî kêm 10 tîp, bi herf û hejmaran.

english: Visible only to event staff for operational contact. Never public.
arabic: يراه موظفو الفعالية فقط للتواصل التشغيلي. لا يظهر للعامة أبدًا.
kurdish: Tenê ji karmendên çalakiyê re ji bo têkiliya karî xuya ye. Qet giştî nabe.

english: {count, plural, =0{Full} =1{1 place left} other{{count} places left}}
arabic: {count, plural, =0{مكتملة} =1{مكان واحد متبقٍ} =2{مكانان متبقيان} few{{count} أماكن متبقية} other{{count} مكانًا متبقيًا}}
kurdish: {count, plural, =0{Tije ye} =1{1 cih maye} other{{count} cih mane}}

english: No points yet. Points come only from approved results in ranking tournaments.
arabic: لا توجد نقاط بعد. تأتي النقاط فقط من النتائج المعتمدة في البطولات المحتسبة.
kurdish: Hîn xal tune. Xal tenê ji encamên pejirandî yên tûrnûvayên rêzbendiyê tên.

english: The RIVALO team has not published this page yet. Check back soon.
arabic: لم ينشر فريق ريفالو هذه الصفحة بعد. عُد قريبًا.
kurdish: Tîma RIVALO hîn ev rûpel neweşandiye. Zû dîsa binêre.

english: This text has not been reviewed by a lawyer yet and may change before RIVALO launches publicly.
arabic: لم يراجع محامٍ هذا النص بعد، وقد يتغير قبل الإطلاق العام لريفالو.
kurdish: Ev nivîs hîn ji aliyê parêzerekî ve nehatiye nirxandin û dibe ku berî destpêkirina giştî ya RIVALO biguhere.

english: Not translated yet. Showing the English text.
arabic: لم تُترجم بعد. يُعرض النص الإنجليزي.
kurdish: Hîn nehatiye wergerandin. Nivîsa îngilîzî tê nîşandan.

english: Your email, phone and payment records are always private.
arabic: بريدك الإلكتروني وهاتفك وسجلات الدفع خاصة دائمًا.
kurdish: E-name, telefon û tomarên dayînê yên te her dem taybet in.

english: When off, only your username is shown.
arabic: عند الإيقاف، يظهر اسم المستخدم فقط.
kurdish: Dema girtî be, tenê navê bikarhêner xuya dibe.

english: Estimated amounts can change. Guaranteed prizes are backed by sponsor money already received.
arabic: المبالغ التقديرية قد تتغير. الجوائز المضمونة مدعومة بأموال رعاة تم استلامها بالفعل.
kurdish: Mîqdarên texmînî dikarin biguherin. Xelatên garantîkirî bi pereyê sponsoran ê ku hatiye wergirtin piştgirî dibin.

english: No badges yet. Badges come from approved results, final placements and check-ins.
arabic: لا توجد أوسمة بعد. تأتي الأوسمة من النتائج المعتمدة والترتيب النهائي وتسجيل الحضور.
kurdish: Hîn nîşan tune. Nîşan ji encamên pejirandî, rêzbendiya dawî û amadebûnê tên.

english: Hidden by this player's privacy settings.
arabic: مخفي حسب إعدادات خصوصية هذا اللاعب.
kurdish: Li gorî mîhengên nepeniyê yên vî lîstikvanî veşartî ye.
Tûrnûvayên temamkirî dê li vir xuya bibin.

english: No points yet. Points are awarded only for approved results.
arabic: لا نقاط بعد. تُمنح النقاط فقط للنتائج المعتمدة.
kurdish: Hîn xal tune. Xal tenê ji bo encamên pejirandî tên dayîn.

english: Leaderboards for each discipline arrive once results are approved under published points rules. No points have been awarded yet.
arabic: تظهر جداول الترتيب لكل فئة بعد اعتماد النتائج وفق قواعد نقاط منشورة. لم تُمنح أي نقاط بعد.
kurdish: Rêzbendiyên her beşê dema ku encam li gorî rêzikên xalan ên weşandî bên pejirandin, tên. Hîn tu xal nehatine dayîn.

english: Points appear once referees approve results in ranking tournaments.
arabic: تظهر النقاط بعد أن يعتمد الحكام النتائج في البطولات المحتسبة.
kurdish: Xal piştî ku hakem encaman di tûrnûvayên rêzbendiyê de dipejirînin xuya dibin.

english: Your history will show which match each point came from.
arabic: سيعرض سجلك المباراة التي جاءت منها كل نقطة.
kurdish: Dîroka te dê nîşan bide ku her xal ji kîjan maçê hatiye.

english: Each discipline gets its own leaderboard for the season.
arabic: لكل تخصص لوحة ترتيب خاصة به في الموسم.
kurdish: Her beş di demsalê de tabloya xwe ya rêzbendiyê heye.
Ji bo her beş û demsalê

english: Points come only from results approved by a referee.
arabic: تأتي النقاط فقط من نتائج يعتمدها حكم.
kurdish: Xal tenê ji encamên ku hakem pejirandine tên.

english: No points table is published for this discipline yet. No points have been awarded.
arabic: لم يُنشر جدول نقاط لهذا التخصص بعد. لم تُمنح أي نقاط.
kurdish: Hîn ji bo vê beşê tabloya xalan nehatiye weşandin. Tu xal nehatine dayîn.

english: Points come only from approved RIVALO tournament results. They can't be bought, and outside results don't count.
arabic: النقاط تأتي فقط من نتائج بطولات ريفالو المعتمدة. لا يمكن شراؤها، ولا تُحتسب النتائج الخارجية.
kurdish: Xal tenê ji encamên pejirandî yên tûrnûvayên RIVALO tên. Nayên kirîn, û encamên derveyî nayên hesibandin.

english: You're registering as an individual for {tournament}.
kurdish: Tu wekî kes di {tournament} de xwe tomar dikî.

english: Before you sign up, you can read our Terms of use, Privacy policy and Community guidelines. Terms and Privacy are drafts until their legal review is complete.
arabic: قبل التسجيل، يمكنك قراءة شروط الاستخدام وسياسة الخصوصية وإرشادات المجتمع. الشروط والخصوصية مسودتان حتى اكتمال مراجعتهما القانونية.
kurdish: Berî ku tu xwe tomar bikî, tu dikarî Mercên bikaranînê, Siyaseta nepeniyê û Rêbernameya civakê bixwînî. Merc û Nepenî heta ku nirxandina wan a hiqûqî temam bibe reşnivîs in.

english: You need to captain a {sport} team to register. Pairs register as two-player teams.
arabic: يجب أن تكون قائد فريق {sport} للتسجيل. الأزواج يسجّلون كفرق من لاعبَين.
kurdish: Ji bo tomarbûnê divê tu kaptanê tîmeke {sport} bî. Cot wekî tîmên du-lîstikvanî tomar dibin.

english: Only members who accepted your invitation can be selected.
arabic: يمكن اختيار الأعضاء الذين قبلوا دعوتك فقط.
kurdish: Tenê endamên ku vexwendina te qebûl kirine dikarin werin hilbijartin.

english: You're in. Your place is reserved.
kurdish: Tu tê de yî. Cihê te hat girtin.

english: The tournament is full. You're on the waitlist.
arabic: البطولة ممتلئة. أنت في قائمة الانتظار.
kurdish: Tûrnûva tije ye. Tu li lîsteya bendemayînê yî.

english: Create a free account to report players or teams.
arabic: أنشئ حسابًا مجانيًا للإبلاغ عن اللاعبين أو الفرق.
kurdish: Ji bo rapora lîstikvan an tîman hesabekî belaş ava bike.

english: What were you doing when it happened?
arabic: ماذا كنت تفعل عندما حدث ذلك؟
kurdish: Dema ku ew qewimî te çi dikir?

english: Tell the RIVALO team what went wrong or what would make the app better. We add your app version automatically.
arabic: أخبر فريق ريفالو بما حدث من خطأ أو بما يجعل التطبيق أفضل. نضيف إصدار التطبيق تلقائيًا.
kurdish: Ji tîma RIVALO re bibêje çi xelet çû an çi dê sepanê baştir bike. Em guhertoya sepanê bixweber lê zêde dikin.

english: Report a problem or send feedback
arabic: الإبلاغ عن مشكلة أو إرسال ملاحظات
kurdish: Pirsgirêkekê rapor bike an nerîna xwe bişîne
Bi kurtî ji me re bibêje çi qewimî.

english: The RIVALO team reads every message.
Reports are private. We never tell the other player who reported them.
arabic: البلاغات سرية. لا نخبر اللاعب الآخر أبدًا بمن أبلغ عنه.
kurdish: Rapor veşartî ne. Em qet ji lîstikvanê din re nabêjin kê rapor kiriye.

arabic: رسائل مزعجة أو احتيال أو مراهنات

english: Our team will review it. You'll get a message in your inbox when they have.
arabic: سيراجعه فريقنا. ستصلك رسالة في صندوق الوارد بعد المراجعة.
kurdish: Tîma me dê wê binirxîne. Piştî wê tu dê di sindoqa xwe de peyamekê bistînî.
Spas ku te ji me re got
Encam ji hakem re hat şandin.

english: Level score? Choose who won the tiebreak.
arabic: تعادل؟ اختر من فاز في كسر التعادل.
kurdish: Wekhev? Kî di tiebreakê de bi ser ket?

english: Create a free account to apply to sell.
arabic: أنشئ حسابًا مجانيًا لتقديم طلب البيع.
kurdish: Ji bo serlêdana firotinê hesabekî belaş ava bike.
Tu li ser RIVALO wek {shop} difiroşî

english: RIVALO is not accepting new sellers right now.
arabic: لا تقبل RIVALO بائعين جددًا حاليًا.
kurdish: RIVALO niha firoşkarên nû qebûl nake.
Derbarê berhemên xwe de ji me re bibêje

english: Brands, what you make, where you sell today.
arabic: العلامات التجارية، ما تصنعه، وأين تبيع حاليًا.
kurdish: Marke, tu çi çêdikî, tu niha li ku difiroşî.

english: Apply here. RIVALO staff check who you are and sign an agreement with you, including the commission.
arabic: قدّم طلبك هنا. يتحقق موظفو RIVALO من هويتك ويوقّعون معك اتفاقية تشمل العمولة.
kurdish: Li vir serlêdanê bike. Karmendên RIVALO kontrol dikin tu kî yî û bi te re peymanekê îmze dikin, komîsyon jî tê de.

english: Add your products in the Seller Hub on a computer. Staff review each one before it goes on sale.
arabic: أضف منتجاتك في مركز البائعين من حاسوب. يراجع الموظفون كل منتج قبل عرضه للبيع.
kurdish: Berhemên xwe ji komputerê li Navenda Firoşkaran zêde bike. Karmend her yekê berî firotinê dinirxînin.

english: Bring your stock to RIVALO. We hand it to customers, take the cash and pay you what you earned, minus the commission.
arabic: أحضر مخزونك إلى RIVALO. نسلّمه للعملاء ونستلم الثمن نقدًا وندفع لك أرباحك بعد خصم العمولة.
kurdish: Stoka xwe bîne RIVALO. Em wê radestî kirrîyaran dikin, pereyê kaş distînin û qezenca te, bêyî komîsyonê, didin te.

english: Manage your products, sales and statement in the Seller Hub. Sign in on a computer with your RIVALO account and your authenticator app.
arabic: أدِر منتجاتك ومبيعاتك وكشف حسابك في مركز البائعين. سجّل الدخول من حاسوب بحسابك في RIVALO وتطبيق المصادقة.
kurdish: Berhem, firotin û hesabnameya xwe li Navenda Firoşkaran birêve bibe. Ji komputerê bi hesabê xwe yê RIVALO û sepana xwe ya piştrastkirinê têkeve.

english: Approved shops and makers can sell their products in the RIVALO store.
arabic: يمكن للمتاجر والصنّاع المعتمدين بيع منتجاتهم في متجر RIVALO.
kurdish: Firotgeh û çêkerên pejirandî dikarin berhemên xwe li firotgeha RIVALO bifiroşin.
Rûpela firotgehê an profîla civakî (ne mecbûrî)

english: RIVALO staff will contact you about the seller agreement. You will get a message in your inbox when they decide.
arabic: سيتواصل معك موظفو RIVALO بشأن اتفاقية البائع. ستصلك رسالة في صندوق الوارد عند اتخاذ القرار.
kurdish: Karmendên RIVALO dê derbarê peymana firoşkar de bi te re têkilî daynin. Dema ku biryar bidin, tu dê di qutiya peyaman de peyamekê bistînî.

english: Enter a phone number (digits, spaces, + and - only).
arabic: أدخل رقم هاتف (أرقام ومسافات و+ و- فقط).
kurdish: Hejmareke telefonê binivîse (tenê hejmar, valahî, + û -).

english: No reason was given. You can contact support from Settings.
arabic: لم يُذكر سبب. يمكنك التواصل مع الدعم من الإعدادات.
kurdish: Sedemek nehat dayîn. Tu dikarî ji Mîhengan bi piştgiriyê re têkilî daynî.

english: Your last application was not approved
arabic: لم تتم الموافقة على طلبك الأخير
kurdish: Serlêdana te ya dawî nehat pejirandin

english: Run a sports shop or make gear? Apply to sell to RIVALO players.
arabic: تملك متجرًا رياضيًا أو تصنع معدات؟ قدّم طلبًا للبيع للاعبي RIVALO.
kurdish: Firotgeheke werzişî ya te heye an tu alavan çêdikî? Ji bo firotina ji lîstikvanên RIVALO re serlêdanê bike.

english: Before you apply, read how selling on RIVALO works.
arabic: قبل التقديم، اقرأ كيف يعمل البيع عبر RIVALO.
kurdish: Berî serlêdanê, bixwîne ka firotin li ser RIVALO çawa dixebite.

english: See your shop in the store
The support contact will be published before launch.
kurdish: Navnîşana piştgiriyê dê berî destpêkirinê were weşandin.

english: Sign out on every device, including this one?
arabic: تسجيل الخروج من كل الأجهزة، بما فيها هذا الجهاز؟
kurdish: Ji hemû amûran derkevî, ev amûr jî tê de?

english: Sign out of RIVALO on this device?
arabic: تسجيل الخروج من ريفالو على هذا الجهاز؟
kurdish: Li ser vê amûrê ji RIVALO derkevî?

english: Create a free account to buy from the RIVALO store.
arabic: أنشئ حسابًا مجانيًا للشراء من متجر ريفالو.
kurdish: Ji bo kirîna ji firotgeha RIVALO hesabekî belaş ava bike.

english: Pay in cash when you collect your order or when it is delivered. There is no card payment in the app.
arabic: ادفع نقدًا عند استلام طلبك أو عند توصيله. لا يوجد دفع بالبطاقة في التطبيق.
kurdish: Dema ku tu fermana xwe distînî an dema ku tê gihandin, bi pereyê kaş bide. Di sepanê de dayîna bi kartê tune.

english: Official RIVALO products will appear here.
kurdish: Berhemên fermî yên RIVALO dê li vir xuya bibin.

arabic: {count, plural, =1{بقيت قطعة واحدة فقط} other{بقي {count} فقط}}

english: Sold by an approved seller. RIVALO keeps the stock, hands it over and takes the payment, so pickup, delivery and returns work as for official products.
arabic: يبيعه بائع معتمد. تحتفظ RIVALO بالمخزون وتسلّم المنتج وتستلم الدفع، لذا يتم الاستلام والتوصيل والإرجاع كما في المنتجات الرسمية.
kurdish: Firoşkarekî pejirandî difiroşe. RIVALO stokê diparêze, berhemê radestî te dike û pereyê distîne, ji ber vê yekê wergirtin, gihandin û vegerandin wek berhemên fermî dixebitin.
Niha tiştek ji bo firotinê tune

english: It may be paused or closed.
arabic: قد يكون متوقفًا مؤقتًا أو مغلقًا.
kurdish: Dibe ku bi demkî hatibe rawestandin an girtin.

english: You'll be the captain. Pairs, such as padel doubles, are two-player teams.
arabic: ستكون القائد. الأزواج، مثل زوجي البادل، هي فرق من لاعبَين.
kurdish: Tu dê bibî kaptan. Cot, wek padela duyî, tîmên du-lîstikvanî ne.

english: Disband {team}? All members are released. Tournament history is kept.
arabic: حلّ {team}؟ سيُحرَّر جميع الأعضاء. يُحفظ سجل البطولات.
kurdish: {team} hilweşînî? Hemû endam azad dibin. Dîroka tûrnûvayan tê parastin.

english: Leave {team}? Rosters already submitted to tournaments don't change.
arabic: مغادرة {team}؟ التشكيلات المُقدَّمة للبطولات لا تتغير.
kurdish: Ji {team} derkevî? Lîsteyên ku berê ji tûrnûvayan re hatine şandin naguherin.

english: Changes here never alter rosters already submitted to tournaments.
arabic: التغييرات هنا لا تعدّل أبدًا التشكيلات المقدَّمة مسبقًا للبطولات.
kurdish: Guhertinên li vir qet lîsteyên ku berê ji tûrnûvayan re hatine şandin naguherînin.

english: Create a team or accept an invitation to play in team and pair tournaments.
arabic: أنشئ فريقًا أو اقبل دعوة للعب في بطولات الفرق والأزواج.
kurdish: Tîmekê ava bike an vexwendinekê qebûl bike da ku di tûrnûvayên tîm û cotan de bilîzî.

english: {name} must accept before becoming captain. You'll become a regular member.
arabic: يجب أن يوافق {name} قبل أن يصبح القائد. ستصبح عضوًا عاديًا.
kurdish: Divê {name} berî ku bibe kaptan qebûl bike. Tu dê bibî endamekî asayî.
Li benda qebûlkirina kaptaniyê ji aliyê {name} ve.

english: Published tournaments appear here. Check back soon.
arabic: تظهر البطولات المنشورة هنا. عُد قريبًا.
kurdish: Tûrnûvayên weşandî li vir xuya dibin. Paşê dîsa binêre.

english: 3–30 characters: letters, numbers, _ and . This is public.
arabic: من 3 إلى 30 حرفًا: أحرف وأرقام و _ و . وهو ظاهر للجميع.
kurdish: 3–30 tîp: herf, hejmar, _ û . Ev giştî ye.

english: Use at least 10 characters with letters and numbers
arabic: استخدم 10 أحرف على الأقل تتضمن أحرفًا وأرقامًا
kurdish: Herî kêm 10 tîp bi herf û hejmaran bi kar bîne

arabic: استخدم من 3 إلى 30 حرفًا أو رقمًا أو _ أو .
kurdish: 3–30 herf, hejmar, _ an . bi kar bîne

english: Needed to join teams and register for tournaments.
arabic: مطلوب للانضمام إلى الفرق والتسجيل في البطولات.
kurdish: Ji bo tevlîbûna tîman û tomarbûna di tûrnûvayan de pêwîst e.

english: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it on any device. A verified email is needed to join teams and register for tournaments.
arabic: أرسلنا رابط تحقق إلى {email}. افتحه على أي جهاز. تحتاج إلى بريد موثّق للانضمام إلى الفرق والتسجيل في البطولات.
kurdish: Me girêdanek piştrastkirinê ji {email} re şand. Wê li ser her amûrekê veke. Ji bo tevlîbûna tîman û tomarbûna di tûrnûvayan de e-nameyeke piştrastkirî pêwîst e.

english: Your email isn't verified yet. Open the link in the email, then try again.
arabic: بريدك لم يُوثَّق بعد. افتح الرابط في البريد ثم حاول مرة أخرى.
kurdish: E-nameya te hîn nehatiye piştrastkirin. Girêdana di e-nameyê de veke, paşê dîsa biceribîne.

english: Join local tournaments in football, padel, cue sports and e-sports. Points come only from approved RIVALO results.
arabic: انضم إلى البطولات المحلية في كرة القدم والبادل ورياضات البلياردو والرياضات الإلكترونية. النقاط تأتي فقط من نتائج ريفالو المعتمدة.
kurdish: Tevlî tûrnûvayên herêmî yên futbol, padel, bîlardo û werzîşên elektronîk bibe. Xal tenê ji encamên pejirandî yên RIVALO tên.

key: :item is no longer available. Remove it from your bag.
english: :item is no longer available. Remove it from your bag.
arabic: :item لم يعد متاحًا. أزله من حقيبتك.
kurdish: :item êdî ne berdest e. Wê ji çenteyê xwe rake.
:match di :tournament de saet :time dest pê dike.

key: :old is now called :team because the name did not follow our community guidelines.
english: :old is now called :team because the name did not follow our community guidelines.
arabic: أصبح اسم :old الآن :team لأن الاسم لم يلتزم بإرشادات المجتمع.
kurdish: Navê :old niha :team e ji ber ku nav li gorî rêbernameya civaka me nebû.

key: :team invited you to join the team.
english: :team invited you to join the team.

key: A dispute about this result is already open.
english: A dispute about this result is already open.
arabic: يوجد اعتراض مفتوح على هذه النتيجة بالفعل.
kurdish: Îtîrazek li ser vê encamê berê vekirî ye.

key: A knockout match needs a winner. Record a walkover or forfeit instead.
english: A knockout match needs a winner. Record a walkover or forfeit instead.
arabic: مباراة خروج المغلوب تحتاج إلى فائز. سجّل فوزاً بالانسحاب أو التنازل بدلاً من ذلك.
kurdish: Maça derketinê serkeftiyekî pêwîst dike. Li şûna wê serkeftina bê lîstin an dev jê berdanê tomar bike.

key: A later match that depends on this result has already been played. Correct that match first.
english: A later match that depends on this result has already been played. Correct that match first.
arabic: لُعبت مباراة لاحقة تعتمد على هذه النتيجة. صحّح تلك المباراة أولاً.
kurdish: Maçeke paşê ya ku bi vê encamê ve girêdayî ye berê hatiye lîstin. Pêşî wê maçê rast bike.

key: A message from the RIVALO team
english: A message from the RIVALO team

key: A place opened up in :tournament. Your entry is now reserved.
english: A place opened up in :tournament. Your entry is now reserved.
arabic: توفر مكان في :tournament. أصبح تسجيلك محجوزاً.
kurdish: Di :tournament de cihek vala bû. Tomara te niha hatiye girtin.

key: A player cannot be both a starter and a substitute.
english: A player cannot be both a starter and a substitute.
arabic: لا يمكن أن يكون اللاعب أساسيًا واحتياطيًا في الوقت نفسه.
kurdish: Lîstikvanek nikare hem sereke hem yedek be.

key: A reason is required for a forced captain transfer.
english: A reason is required for a forced captain transfer.
arabic: يجب ذكر سبب لنقل القيادة الإجباري.
kurdish: Ji bo veguhastina neçarî ya kaptaniyê sedemek pêwîst e.

key: A reason is required when staff cancel a registration.
english: A reason is required when staff cancel a registration.
arabic: يجب ذكر سبب عند إلغاء الموظفين لتسجيل.
kurdish: Dema karmend tomarbûnekê betal dikin, sedemek pêwîst e.

key: A team with this name already exists in this sport.
english: A team with this name already exists in this sport.
arabic: يوجد فريق بهذا الاسم في هذه الرياضة بالفعل.
kurdish: Di vê werzîşê de tîmeke bi vî navî berê heye.

key: Another staff member must handle a report that involves you.
english: Another staff member must handle a report that involves you.
arabic: يجب أن يعالج موظف آخر بلاغًا يتعلق بك.
kurdish: Divê karmendekî din raporeke ku têkildarî te ye bişopîne.

key: Both opponents must be known before a result can be entered.
english: Both opponents must be known before a result can be entered.
arabic: يجب معرفة الطرفين قبل إدخال النتيجة.
kurdish: Berî nivîsandina encamê divê her du hevrik diyar bin.

key: Bring the stock to RIVALO so customers can buy it.
english: Bring the stock to RIVALO so customers can buy it.
arabic: أحضر المخزون إلى RIVALO ليتمكن العملاء من شرائه.
kurdish: Stokê bîne RIVALO da ku kirrîyar karibin bikirin.

key: Cancel the team's active tournament registrations before disbanding.
english: Cancel the team's active tournament registrations before disbanding.
arabic: ألغِ تسجيلات الفريق النشطة في البطولات قبل حلّه.
kurdish: Berî hilweşandinê tomarbûnên çalak ên tîmê yên tûrnûvayan betal bike.

key: Captaincy is assigned through a captain transfer, not an invitation.
english: Captaincy is assigned through a captain transfer, not an invitation.
arabic: تُمنح القيادة عبر نقل القيادة، وليس عبر دعوة.
kurdish: Kaptanî bi veguhastina kaptaniyê tê dayîn, ne bi vexwendinê.

key: Check-in and payments are only possible while the tournament is open for registration, closed for registration, or in progress.
english: Check-in and payments are only possible while the tournament is open for registration, closed for registration, or in progress.
arabic: تسجيل الحضور والدفع ممكنان فقط عندما يكون التسجيل مفتوحًا أو مغلقًا أو أثناء سير البطولة.
kurdish: Amadebûn û dayîn tenê dema ku tomarbûna tûrnûvayê vekirî an girtî be, an tûrnûva dewam dike, gengaz in.

key: Choose a reason that fits what you are reporting.
english: Choose a reason that fits what you are reporting.
arabic: اختر سببًا يناسب ما تبلّغ عنه.
kurdish: Sedemekê hilbijêre ku li gorî tiştê tu rapor dikî be.

key: Choose a team (pairs register as a two-player team).
english: Choose a team (pairs register as a two-player team).
arabic: اختر فريقًا (يُسجَّل الثنائي كفريق من لاعبَين).
kurdish: Tîmekê hilbijêre (cot wekî tîmeke du-lîstikvanî tomar dibin).
Di navbera :min û :max lîstikvanan de hilbijêre.

key: Choose who or what you are reporting.
english: Choose who or what you are reporting.
arabic: اختر من أو ما الذي تبلّغ عنه.
kurdish: Hilbijêre tu kê an çi rapor dikî.
Hilbijêre kî bi :outcome bi ser dikeve.

key: Collect it at :place. Bring the order number; you pay in cash on pickup.
english: Collect it at :place. Bring the order number; you pay in cash on pickup.
arabic: استلمه من :place. أحضر رقم الطلب؛ تدفع نقدًا عند الاستلام.
kurdish: Wê ji :place bistîne. Hejmara fermanê bi xwe re bîne; dema wergirtinê bi kaş didî.

key: Confirm that you checked who the seller is before approving.
english: Confirm that you checked who the seller is before approving.
arabic: أكّد أنك تحققت من هوية البائع قبل الاعتماد.
kurdish: Berî pejirandinê piştrast bike ku te kontrol kir firoşkar kî ye.

key: Delivery is not available to this area. Choose another area or pickup.
english: Delivery is not available to this area. Choose another area or pickup.
arabic: التوصيل غير متاح لهذه المنطقة. اختر منطقة أخرى أو الاستلام.
kurdish: Gihandin ji bo vê herêmê ne berdest e. Herêmeke din an wergirtinê hilbijêre.

key: Describe what you checked (for example the ID or business registration you saw).
english: Describe what you checked (for example the ID or business registration you saw).
arabic: صِف ما تحققت منه (مثلًا الهوية أو السجل التجاري الذي اطّلعت عليه).
kurdish: Binivîse te çi kontrol kir (mînak nasname an tomara bazirganiyê ya ku te dît).
Her set du xalan pêwîst dike.

key: Enter a new team name (2 to 60 characters).
english: Enter a new team name (2 to 60 characters).
arabic: أدخل اسمًا جديدًا للفريق (من 2 إلى 60 حرفًا).
kurdish: Navekî nû ji bo tîmê binivîse (2 heta 60 tîp).

key: Enter how many items arrived (1 or more).
english: Enter how many items arrived (1 or more).
arabic: أدخل عدد القطع التي وصلت (1 أو أكثر).
kurdish: Binivîse çend berhem gihîştin (1 an zêdetir).

key: Enter how many items were handed back (1 or more).
english: Enter how many items were handed back (1 or more).
arabic: أدخل عدد القطع التي سُلّمت (1 أو أكثر).
kurdish: Binivîse çend tişt hatin vegerandin (1 an zêdetir).

key: Enter the corrected result to uphold the dispute.
english: Enter the corrected result to uphold the dispute.
kurdish: Ji bo qebûlkirina îtîrazê encama rastkirî binivîse.

key: Enter the name, phone number and address for delivery.
english: Enter the name, phone number and address for delivery.
arabic: أدخل الاسم ورقم الهاتف والعنوان للتوصيل.
kurdish: Ji bo gihandinê nav, hejmara telefonê û navnîşanê binivîse.

key: Enter the reference of the signed seller agreement.
english: Enter the reference of the signed seller agreement.
kurdish: Referansa peymana firoşkar a îmzekirî binivîse.

key: Enter the score for both sides.
english: Enter the score for both sides.

key: Final placements are already confirmed for this tournament.
english: Final placements are already confirmed for this tournament.
arabic: الترتيب النهائي لهذه البطولة مؤكد بالفعل.
kurdish: Rêzbendiya dawî ya vê tûrnûvayê berê hatiye piştrastkirin.

key: Fixtures for :tournament are published. See who you play.
english: Fixtures for :tournament are published. See who you play.
kurdish: Maçên :tournament hatin weşandin. Bibîne tu bi kê re dilîzî.

key: Have the cash ready: you pay when it arrives.
english: Have the cash ready: you pay when it arrives.
arabic: جهّز المبلغ نقدًا: تدفع عند الوصول.
kurdish: Pereyê kaş amade bike: dema ku bigihîje didî.

key: Knockout matches cannot end level. Choose who won the tiebreak.
english: Knockout matches cannot end level. Choose who won the tiebreak.
arabic: مباريات خروج المغلوب لا تنتهي بالتعادل. اختر من فاز في كسر التعادل.
kurdish: Maçên derketinê nikarin wekhev biqedin. Hilbijêre kê di tiebreakê de bi ser ket.

key: One or more players are already registered in this tournament.
english: One or more players are already registered in this tournament.
arabic: لاعب واحد أو أكثر مسجّل في هذه البطولة بالفعل.
kurdish: Yek an çend lîstikvan berê di vê tûrnûvayê de tomar bûne.

key: One or more selected sports or games are not available.
english: One or more selected sports or games are not available.
arabic: رياضة أو لعبة واحدة أو أكثر من اختياراتك غير متاحة.
kurdish: Yek an çend werzîş an lîstikên hilbijartî ne berdest in.

key: Only :count of :item left. Update your bag.
english: Only :count of :item left. Update your bag.
kurdish: Tenê :count ji :item mane. Çenteyê xwe nû bike.

key: Only a submitted result can be approved.
english: Only a submitted result can be approved.
kurdish: Tenê encameke şandî dikare were pejirandin.

key: Only a submitted result can be rejected.
english: Only a submitted result can be rejected.
kurdish: Tenê encameke şandî dikare were redkirin.

key: Only a super admin can suspend a staff account.
english: Only a super admin can suspend a staff account.
arabic: وحده المدير العام يمكنه تعليق حساب موظف.
kurdish: Tenê rêveberê giştî dikare hesabê karmendekî rawestîne.

key: Only accepted, active team members can be added to the roster.
english: Only accepted, active team members can be added to the roster.
arabic: يمكن إضافة أعضاء الفريق النشطين الذين قبلوا الدعوة فقط إلى التشكيلة.
kurdish: Tenê endamên çalak ên ku vexwendin qebûl kirine dikarin li lîsteyê werin zêdekirin.

key: Only an approved result can be disputed.
english: Only an approved result can be disputed.
arabic: يمكن الاعتراض على النتيجة المعتمدة فقط.
kurdish: Tenê li encameke pejirandî dikare îtîraz were kirin.

key: Only an assigned referee can approve or correct results.
english: Only an assigned referee can approve or correct results.
arabic: الحكم المعيّن فقط يمكنه اعتماد النتائج أو تصحيحها.
kurdish: Tenê hakemê destnîşankirî dikare encaman bipejirîne an rast bike.

key: Only entries with a reserved place can check in.
english: Only entries with a reserved place can check in.
arabic: يمكن تسجيل الحضور فقط للاشتراكات التي لها مكان محجوز.
kurdish: Tenê beşdarên ku cihê wan hatiye girtin dikarin amadebûna xwe tomar bikin.

key: Only players in this match can dispute its result.
english: Only players in this match can dispute its result.
arabic: لاعبو هذه المباراة فقط يمكنهم الاعتراض على نتيجتها.
kurdish: Tenê lîstikvanên vê maçê dikarin îtîrazî encama wê bikin.

key: Only players in this match or tournament staff can submit its result.
english: Only players in this match or tournament staff can submit its result.
arabic: لاعبو هذه المباراة أو طاقم البطولة فقط يمكنهم إرسال نتيجتها.
kurdish: Tenê lîstikvanên vê maçê an karmendên tûrnûvayê dikarin encama wê bişînin.

key: Only reserved entries can be marked as no-show.
english: Only reserved entries can be marked as no-show.
arabic: يمكن تسجيل الغياب للتسجيلات المحجوزة فقط.
kurdish: Tenê beşdarên bi cihê girtî dikarin wekî nehatî werin nîşankirin.

key: Only seller products can be returned to a seller.
english: Only seller products can be returned to a seller.
arabic: يمكن إعادة منتجات البائعين فقط إلى البائع.
kurdish: Tenê berhemên firoşkaran dikarin ji firoşkar re werin vegerandin.

key: Only staff who manage sellers can do this.
english: Only staff who manage sellers can do this.
arabic: هذا متاح فقط للموظفين المسؤولين عن البائعين.
kurdish: Tenê karmendên ku firoşkaran birêve dibin dikarin vê bikin.

key: Only team and pair rosters can be edited.
english: Only team and pair rosters can be edited.
arabic: يمكن تعديل تشكيلات الفرق والثنائيات فقط.
kurdish: Tenê lîsteyên tîm û cotan dikarin werin guhertin.

key: Only the captain can transfer captaincy.
english: Only the captain can transfer captaincy.

key: Only the team captain can register the team.
english: Only the team captain can register the team.
arabic: قائد الفريق وحده يمكنه تسجيل الفريق.
kurdish: Tenê kaptanê tîmê dikare tîmê tomar bike.

key: Only tournament staff can record a cancellation or disqualification.
english: Only tournament staff can record a cancellation or disqualification.
arabic: طاقم البطولة فقط يمكنه تسجيل إلغاء أو استبعاد.
kurdish: Tenê karmendên tûrnûvayê dikarin betalkirin an derxistinê tomar bikin.

key: Please read our community guidelines. Repeated breaches can lead to suspension.
english: Please read our community guidelines. Repeated breaches can lead to suspension.
arabic: يرجى قراءة إرشادات المجتمع. تكرار المخالفات قد يؤدي إلى تعليق الحساب.
kurdish: Ji kerema xwe rêbernameya civaka me bixwîne. Binpêkirinên dubare dikarin bibin sedema rawestandina hesabê.

key: Prices or fees changed since you opened checkout. Check the new total.
english: Prices or fees changed since you opened checkout. Check the new total.
arabic: تغيّرت الأسعار أو الرسوم منذ فتحت صفحة الدفع. راجع المجموع الجديد.
kurdish: Ji dema ku te rûpela temamkirinê vekir ve biha an heq guherîn. Berhevoka nû kontrol bike.

key: Registration has closed. Contact the organizer to withdraw.
english: Registration has closed. Contact the organizer to withdraw.
arabic: أُغلق التسجيل. تواصل مع المنظّم للانسحاب.
kurdish: Tomarbûn hatiye girtin. Ji bo vekişînê bi rêxistinkar re têkilî dayne.

key: Registration is not open for this tournament.
english: Registration is not open for this tournament.
kurdish: Tomarbûn ji bo vê tûrnûvayê ne vekirî ye.

key: Results can only be recorded while the tournament is being played.
english: Results can only be recorded while the tournament is being played.
arabic: تُسجَّل النتائج فقط أثناء سير البطولة.
kurdish: Encam tenê dema ku tûrnûva tê lîstin dikarin werin tomarkirin.

key: RIVALO recorded a payment of :amount to you. Check your statement in the Seller Hub.
english: RIVALO recorded a payment of :amount to you. Check your statement in the Seller Hub.
arabic: سجّلت RIVALO دفعة بقيمة :amount لك. راجع كشف حسابك في مركز البائعين.
kurdish: RIVALO dravdaneke :amount ji te re tomar kir. Hesabnameya xwe li Navenda Firoşkaran kontrol bike.

key: Scores must be whole numbers from 0 to 999.
english: Scores must be whole numbers from 0 to 999.
arabic: يجب أن تكون النتائج أعداداً صحيحة من 0 إلى 999.
kurdish: Xal divê hejmarên tam ji 0 heta 999 bin.

key: Selling on RIVALO is not open yet.
english: Selling on RIVALO is not open yet.
arabic: البيع عبر RIVALO غير متاح بعد.
kurdish: Firotin li ser RIVALO hîn ne vekirî ye.

key: Show your check-in code at the venue for :tournament.
english: Show your check-in code at the venue for :tournament.
arabic: اعرض رمز تسجيل الحضور في مكان :tournament.
kurdish: Koda amadebûnê li cihê :tournament nîşan bide.

key: Sign in to see tournaments for you.
english: Sign in to see tournaments for you.
arabic: سجّل الدخول لرؤية البطولات المناسبة لك.
kurdish: Têkeve da ku tûrnûvayên ji bo te bibînî.

key: Teams are not available for this sport.
english: Teams are not available for this sport.
kurdish: Ji bo vê werzîşê tîm ne berdest in.

key: Teams in this sport may have at most :limit members.
english: Teams in this sport may have at most :limit members.
arabic: يمكن أن يضم الفريق في هذه الرياضة :limit أعضاء كحد أقصى.
kurdish: Tîmên di vê werzîşê de dikarin herî zêde :limit endam hebin.
Bi kurtî ji me re bibêje çi qewimî.

key: The applicant's account is not active.
english: The applicant's account is not active.

key: The captain cannot be removed. Transfer captaincy first.
english: The captain cannot be removed. Transfer captaincy first.
arabic: لا يمكن إزالة القائد. انقل القيادة أولًا.
kurdish: Kaptan nikare were derxistin. Pêşî kaptaniyê veguhezîne.

key: The chosen winner does not match the score.
english: The chosen winner does not match the score.
kurdish: Serkeftiyê hilbijartî li gorî encamê nîne.

key: The commission must be between 0 % and 100 %.
english: The commission must be between 0 % and 100 %.
arabic: يجب أن تكون العمولة بين 0 % و100 %.
kurdish: Komîsyon divê di navbera 0 % û 100 % de be.

key: The counted stock cannot be negative.
english: The counted stock cannot be negative.
arabic: لا يمكن أن يكون المخزون المعدود سالبًا.

key: The logo of :team was removed because it did not follow our community guidelines.
english: The logo of :team was removed because it did not follow our community guidelines.
arabic: أُزيل شعار :team لأنه لم يلتزم بإرشادات المجتمع.
kurdish: Logoya :team hat rakirin ji ber ku li gorî rêbernameya civaka me nebû.

key: The new captain must be an active member of the team.
english: The new captain must be an active member of the team.
arabic: يجب أن يكون القائد الجديد عضوًا نشطًا في الفريق.
kurdish: Divê kaptanê nû endamekî çalak ê tîmê be.

key: The new captain must be another active member of the team.
english: The new captain must be another active member of the team.
arabic: يجب أن يكون القائد الجديد عضوًا نشطًا آخر في الفريق.
kurdish: Divê kaptanê nû endamekî din ê çalak ê tîmê be.

key: The quantity must not be zero.
english: The quantity must not be zero.

key: The RIVALO team has read your message.
english: The RIVALO team has read your message.

key: The store is not open yet.
english: The store is not open yet.

key: The team captain has changed since this transfer was requested.
english: The team captain has changed since this transfer was requested.
arabic: تغيّر قائد الفريق منذ طلب هذا النقل.
kurdish: Ji dema daxwaza vê veguhastinê ve kaptanê tîmê guheriye.

key: The time to dispute this result has passed (:hours hours after approval).
english: The time to dispute this result has passed (:hours hours after approval).
arabic: انتهت مهلة الاعتراض على هذه النتيجة (:hours ساعة بعد الاعتماد).
kurdish: Dema îtîrazkirina vê encamê derbas bûye (:hours saet piştî pejirandinê).

key: This account is not available. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
english: This account is not available. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
arabic: هذا الحساب غير متاح. تواصل مع الدعم إذا كنت تعتقد أن هذا خطأ.
kurdish: Ev hesab ne berdest e. Heke tu difikirî ku ev şaşî ye, bi piştgiriyê re têkilî dayne.

key: This action does not apply to this report.
english: This action does not apply to this report.
arabic: هذا الإجراء لا ينطبق على هذا البلاغ.
kurdish: Ev kiryar ji bo vê raporê nayê bikaranîn.

arabic: تم البتّ في هذا الطلب بالفعل.
kurdish: Biryara vê serlêdanê jixwe hatiye dayîn.

arabic: تم البت في هذا الاعتراض بالفعل.

key: This invitation is addressed to another player.
english: This invitation is addressed to another player.
arabic: هذه الدعوة موجّهة إلى لاعب آخر.
kurdish: Ev vexwendin ji lîstikvanekî din re ye.

key: This invitation is no longer open.
english: This invitation is no longer open.
kurdish: Ev vexwendin êdî ne vekirî ye.

key: This match already has an approved result. Raise a dispute if it is wrong.
english: This match already has an approved result. Raise a dispute if it is wrong.
arabic: لهذه المباراة نتيجة معتمدة بالفعل. قدّم اعتراضاً إن كانت خاطئة.
kurdish: Encameke pejirandî ya vê maçê berê heye. Heke şaş be, îtîraz bike.

key: This match has no approved result to correct.
english: This match has no approved result to correct.
arabic: لا توجد نتيجة معتمدة لهذه المباراة لتصحيحها.
kurdish: Encameke pejirandî ya vê maçê ji bo rastkirinê tune ye.

key: This match is not waiting for a result.
english: This match is not waiting for a result.
kurdish: Ev maç li benda encamê nîne.

key: This order belongs to another account.
english: This order belongs to another account.
kurdish: Ev ferman yê hesabekî din e.

key: This order can no longer be cancelled in the app. Contact the store.
english: This order can no longer be cancelled in the app. Contact the store.
arabic: لم يعد ممكنًا إلغاء هذا الطلب من التطبيق. تواصل مع المتجر.
kurdish: Ev ferman êdî di sepanê de nayê betalkirin. Bi firotgehê re têkilî dayne.

key: This person already has a shop.
english: This person already has a shop.

key: This player already has a pending invitation.
english: This player already has a pending invitation.
arabic: لدى هذا اللاعب دعوة معلّقة بالفعل.
kurdish: Vexwendineke li bendê ya vî lîstikvanî berê heye.

key: This player has no display name now.
english: This player has no display name now.
arabic: لا يوجد اسم معروض لهذا اللاعب الآن.
kurdish: Niha navê xuyayî yê vî lîstikvanî tune ye.

key: This player has no profile photo now.
english: This player has no profile photo now.
arabic: لا توجد صورة ملف شخصي لهذا اللاعب الآن.
kurdish: Niha wêneyê profîla vî lîstikvanî tune ye.

key: This player is already a member of the team.
english: This player is already a member of the team.
arabic: هذا اللاعب عضو في الفريق بالفعل.
kurdish: Ev lîstikvan berê endamê tîmê ye.

key: This player is not an active member.
english: This player is not an active member.
kurdish: Ev lîstikvan ne endamekî çalak e.

key: This registration is no longer active.
english: This registration is no longer active.
kurdish: Ev tomarbûn êdî ne çalak e.

key: This report has already been handled.
english: This report has already been handled.

key: This team has no logo now.
english: This team has no logo now.
arabic: لا يوجد شعار لهذا الفريق الآن.
kurdish: Niha logoya vê tîmê tune ye.

key: This team plays a different sport.
english: This team plays a different sport.

key: This tournament accepts individual registrations only.
english: This tournament accepts individual registrations only.
arabic: هذه البطولة تقبل التسجيل الفردي فقط.
kurdish: Ev tûrnûva tenê tomarbûnên kesane qebûl dike.

key: This transfer is addressed to another player.
english: This transfer is addressed to another player.
arabic: طلب النقل هذا موجّه إلى لاعب آخر.
kurdish: Ev veguhastin ji lîstikvanekî din re ye.

key: This transfer is no longer pending.
english: This transfer is no longer pending.
arabic: طلب النقل هذا لم يعد معلّقًا.
kurdish: Ev veguhastin êdî li bendê nîne.

key: Transfer captaincy before leaving the team, or disband it.
english: Transfer captaincy before leaving the team, or disband it.
arabic: انقل القيادة قبل مغادرة الفريق، أو قم بحلّه.
kurdish: Berî derketina ji tîmê kaptaniyê veguhezîne, an tîmê hilweşîne.

key: Transfer captaincy of :teams before deleting your account.
english: Transfer captaincy of :teams before deleting your account.
kurdish: Berî jêbirina hesabê xwe kaptaniya :teams veguhezîne.

key: Use a captain transfer to change the captain.
english: Use a captain transfer to change the captain.
kurdish: Ji bo guhertina kaptan veguhastina kaptaniyê bi kar bîne.

key: Use withdrawal or no-show handling once the tournament has started.
english: Use withdrawal or no-show handling once the tournament has started.
arabic: استخدم الانسحاب أو تسجيل الغياب بعد بدء البطولة.
kurdish: Piştî destpêkirina tûrnûvayê vekişîn an tomarkirina nehatinê bi kar bîne.

key: Verify your email address before applying.
english: Verify your email address before applying.
kurdish: Berî serlêdanê navnîşana e-nameya xwe piştrast bike.

key: Verify your email address before ordering.
english: Verify your email address before ordering.
kurdish: Berî fermandanê navnîşana e-nameya xwe piştrast bike.

key: Verify your email address before registering.
english: Verify your email address before registering.
kurdish: Berî tomarbûnê navnîşana e-nameya xwe piştrast bike.

key: We are preparing it. You pay in cash when you receive it.
english: We are preparing it. You pay in cash when you receive it.
arabic: نحن نجهّزه. تدفع نقدًا عند الاستلام.
kurdish: Em wê amade dikin. Dema ku tu wê distînî bi kaş didî.

key: We reviewed it and did not find a breach of our community guidelines.
english: We reviewed it and did not find a breach of our community guidelines.
arabic: راجعناه ولم نجد مخالفة لإرشادات المجتمع.
kurdish: Me ew nirxand û binpêkirina rêbernameya civaka xwe nedît.

key: We reviewed it and took action under our community guidelines.
english: We reviewed it and took action under our community guidelines.
arabic: راجعناه واتخذنا إجراءً وفق إرشادات المجتمع.
kurdish: Me ew nirxand û li gorî rêbernameya civaka xwe gav avêt.

key: You already have a shop on RIVALO.
english: You already have a shop on RIVALO.
kurdish: Jixwe firotgeheke te li ser RIVALO heye.

key: You already reported this. Our team will review it.
english: You already reported this. Our team will review it.
arabic: لقد أبلغت عن هذا من قبل. سيراجعه فريقنا.
kurdish: Te ev berê rapor kiriye. Tîma me dê wê binirxîne.

key: You are already a member of this team.
english: You are already a member of this team.
arabic: أنت عضو في هذا الفريق بالفعل.
kurdish: Tu berê endamê vê tîmê yî.

key: You can buy at most :count of this item per order.
english: You can buy at most :count of this item per order.
arabic: يمكنك شراء :count قطع كحد أقصى من هذا المنتج في كل طلب.
kurdish: Tu dikarî di her fermanekê de herî zêde :count ji vê berhemê bikirî.

key: You can now sell on RIVALO. Sign in to the Seller Hub on a computer to add your products.
english: You can now sell on RIVALO. Sign in to the Seller Hub on a computer to add your products.
arabic: يمكنك الآن البيع عبر RIVALO. ادخل إلى مركز البائعين من حاسوب لإضافة منتجاتك.
kurdish: Tu niha dikarî li ser RIVALO bifiroşî. Ji bo zêdekirina berhemên xwe ji komputerê têkeve Navenda Firoşkaran.

key: You cannot review or change your own shop. Ask another staff member.
english: You cannot review or change your own shop. Ask another staff member.
arabic: لا يمكنك مراجعة متجرك أو تعديله. اطلب ذلك من موظف آخر.
kurdish: Tu nikarî firotgeha xwe binirxînî an biguherînî. Ji karmendekî din bixwaze.

key: You do not have permission to handle reports.
english: You do not have permission to handle reports.
kurdish: Destûra te tune ku raporan bişopînî.

key: You have :count orders in progress. Collect or cancel one before ordering again.
english: You have :count orders in progress. Collect or cancel one before ordering again.
arabic: لديك :count طلبات قيد التنفيذ. استلم أحدها أو ألغِه قبل الطلب مرة أخرى.
kurdish: :count fermanên te di pêvajoyê de ne. Berî ku dîsa ferman bidî yekê bistîne an betal bike.

key: You have reached the limit of blocked players.
english: You have reached the limit of blocked players.
arabic: وصلت إلى الحد الأقصى للاعبين المحظورين.

key: Your account cannot apply to sell.
english: Your account cannot apply to sell.
kurdish: Hesabê te nikare ji bo firotinê serlêdanê bike.

key: Your account cannot register for tournaments.
english: Your account cannot register for tournaments.
arabic: لا يمكن لحسابك التسجيل في البطولات.
kurdish: Hesabê te nikare di tûrnûvayan de tomar bibe.

key: Your application is already being reviewed.
english: Your application is already being reviewed.

key: Your approved products are back in the store.
english: Your approved products are back in the store.
kurdish: Berhemên te yên pejirandî vegeriyan firotgehê.

key: Your bag is full. Check out or remove something first.
english: Your bag is full. Check out or remove something first.
arabic: حقيبتك ممتلئة. أتمم الطلب أو أزل شيئًا أولًا.
kurdish: Çenteyê te tije ye. Pêşî fermanê temam bike an tiştekî rake.

key: Your display name was removed because it did not follow our community guidelines. Your username is shown until you choose a new one.
english: Your display name was removed because it did not follow our community guidelines. Your username is shown until you choose a new one.
arabic: أُزيل اسمك المعروض لأنه لم يلتزم بإرشادات المجتمع. يظهر اسم المستخدم حتى تختار اسمًا جديدًا.
kurdish: Navê te yê xuyayî hat rakirin ji ber ku li gorî rêbernameya civaka me nebû. Heta ku tu navekî nû hilbijêrî, navê te yê bikarhêner tê nîşandan.
Maça te zû dest pê dike

key: Your products are not shown in the store for now.
english: Your products are not shown in the store for now.
arabic: منتجاتك لا تظهر في المتجر حاليًا.
kurdish: Berhemên te niha li firotgehê nayên nîşandan.

key: Your profile photo was removed because it did not follow our community guidelines. You can choose another one.
english: Your profile photo was removed because it did not follow our community guidelines. You can choose another one.
arabic: أُزيلت صورة ملفك الشخصي لأنها لم تلتزم بإرشادات المجتمع. يمكنك اختيار صورة أخرى.
kurdish: Wêneyê profîla te hat rakirin ji ber ku li gorî rêbernameya civaka me nebû. Tu dikarî yekî din hilbijêrî.

key: Your seller application was not approved
english: Your seller application was not approved
arabic: لم تتم الموافقة على طلبك للبيع
kurdish: Daxwaza te ya firoştinê nehat pejirandin
Firotgeha te bi demkî hat rawestandin
